results.summary: PLEASE SELECT 1 FOR GEORGE ON CALLING - GUIDE PRICE £900K - ASKING PRICE £925K – Well-located mansion block apartments with smart concierge facilities are certainly a rarity these days, so when one comes up, it’s worth a look! This two-bedroom flat could not be in a better location and it has two distinctive advantages over its competition: all the windows are at ground level, with bright views plus it boasts two entrances. The first being through the smart front entrance on Chepstow Villas, and the other, perfect for unloading the shopping or luggage, enters through the flat's main reception room which opens out on to Pencombe Mews, at the back of the building. The accommodation comprises a spacious entrance hallway with inbuilt storage, leading into the open plan reception/kitchen with high ceilings and an abundance of light. The kitchen area comprises a range of matching wall and base units with work surfaces incorporating inset sink unit, gas hob with overhead extractor, electric oven and further space for appliances. There are two well sized double bedrooms plus a modern wet room, quality flooring, inbuilt storage, neutral décor, gas central heating, and secure entry. Thornbury Court is an Edwardian purpose built mansion block conveniently located halfway down Chepstow Villas on the corner of Denbigh Road, close to Holland Park, Ladbroke Grove and Bayswater stations, as well as Paddington train station and numerous regular bus routes connecting the surrounding area. There is also an array of fashionable shops, markets, boutiques and restaurants on both Westbourne Grove and Portobello market with beautiful Kensington Gardens, Hyde Park and Holland Park all within easy reach, offering stunning open spaces and iconic landmarks. Five minutes away is Notting Hill with its Tube Station (Central, District & Circle lines), as well as cinemas, restaurants, and easy access to the M4/M40 corridor and Heathrow Airport. results.summary: Architecture & Interior A quirky Victorian flat spread across the entire second floor of this wonderful & historic building, with beautiful urban views, complete original features and a deceptive amount of space. This has all the core traits of a well-thought-out period conversion. Entering on the second floor, wonderful timber floors and tall ceilings stand out immediately. The reception room has all the period features that the heart desires including a fireplace, original windows, coving and floorboards, exuding vintage ascetic. This is an amazingly social space, with entertaining and dining at the heart of everything, with an almost 360-degree panoramic view of Kentish Town. The kitchen has a homely feel and is cleverly separated from the living area retaining supporting pillars and walls. The principal bedroom leads off the kitchen through a discreet door into a bright big space with built-in wardrobes. A marvellous ensuite leads off here, with huge potential to completely redesign the space. Across the hall, there are two further bright & airy bedrooms with great proportions, period features and a great view of the Kentish Town academy. An additional walk-in wet room is off the hallway. Extra hallway storage is adjacent providing plenty of large item space. In the neighbourhood Situated in the heart of Kentish Town, this is a bustling thoroughfare with a string of excellent pubs, coffee shops, independent shops, supermarkets catering for everything you will need. Kentish Town Road, the local high street, is less than five minutes’ walk away and has pubs, restaurants and essential local services. Directly next to Kentish Town Station, and The Academy, you are completely spoilt for cultural opportunity. Kentish Town baths is your local leisure centre recently renovated with refurbished gym, exercise classes and three different pools. The Bulls Head is just across the road and is a renowned pub, known for its BBQ food and great beer. Opposite the station The Assembly Rooms is perfect for live football and good food. The Phoenicia Mediterranean Food Hall is a locals favourite. They do fantastic lunchtime wraps, as well as superb breads and sweets. Transport & Connections Kentish Town Underground and Mainline Rail station is only a seven-minute walk and connects with the Northern Line. Mainline rail services link to Kings Cross, Farringdon and wider South East London and up as far as Bedford. results.summary: Set within the historic Benyon Arms, a charming former public house dating back to the mid-19th century and later converted into residential apartments, this wonderfully bright two-bedroom apartment at 155 De Beauvoir Road offers spacious accommodation, an excellent layout, and far-reaching views. Large windows flood the property with natural light, while high ceilings and generous proportions create an impressive sense of space throughout. At the centre of the home is an impressive open-plan reception room, carefully arranged to provide distinct areas for both dining and relaxation. The generously sized kitchen sits seamlessly within this space, creating an ideal setting for modern living and entertaining alike. There are two well-proportioned double bedrooms, thoughtfully positioned at either end of the apartment to provide an excellent degree of privacy, together with a large family bathroom. The result is a home that feels both elegant and highly practical. The apartment is ideally located for enjoying all that De Beauvoir has to offer, with an excellent selection of local pubs, cafés and amenities nearby, including the much-loved De Beauvoir Deli. The area is also well connected, with convenient transport links from the Overground as well as numerous bus routes, making access to the City, Shoreditch, Islington and beyond both quick and straightforward. Owner’s Insights What do you love about your home? The light that comes through the large windows is something I’ve always loved, and the high ceilings make the flat feel incredibly spacious. The room sizes are also very generous. Being two storeys above the road gives it a lovely outlook, and there is a real sense of community between the six flats in the building. We meet regularly to discuss residents’ matters, and the communal areas are always kept very clean and tidy. Why are you selling? The time has come where I need to be closer to my family. What do you love about the area? The transport links are excellent, the neighbourhood is very friendly and has a great community feel, and there are great local amenities close by. results.summary: Step into this charming third-floor apartment (with lift) located in St Saviours Wharf, one of Shad Thames' most desirable waterfront Victorian warehouses, offering both convenience and character. This delightful one-bedroom property boasts a south-easterly facing private balcony, with space for small table and chairs, where you can enjoy your morning coffee with a view of the river. Being on an upper floor with good-sized windows the apartment gets plenty of natural light, which is rare for a warehouse property. The reception room has ample space for lounge, dining and a work-from home space and a fitted, fully-equipped kitchen lies just off. The double bedroom is an excellent size, wonderfully presented and also enjoys river views through the large Crittall warehouse window. The apartment is completed by a full, tiled modern bathroom with good storage space. The property has an allocated secure parking space within the parking garage of the building and the building is looked after by a daytime concierge/porter. The property is being sold with no onward chain and has the benefit of a Share of Freehold in addition to the long underlying lease. The Shad Thames neighbourhood is possibly the finest residential areas on the south bank of the river and close to the City. It has some of the best warehouse architecture in London and a stunning waterfront of restaurants and bars. Close to the City and West End, Shad Thames is also a peaceful residential community. results.summary: Tucked away in a peaceful setting bordering open woodland, this beautifully presented modern family home offers a lifestyle that effortlessly balances comfort, style, and a strong connection to nature. Built just six years ago and maintained to an immaculate standard throughout, the house immediately feels welcoming and thoughtfully designed for modern living. The heart of the home is the stunning lounge, a light-filled space with elegant doors opening directly onto the west-facing garden — perfect for seamless indoor-outdoor living and relaxed evenings enjoying the sunset. The garden itself is a real highlight, soaking up sunshine for most of the day and providing an ideal backdrop for family time, entertaining, or simply unwinding. The kitchen is both stylish and practical, finished in beautiful condition and spacious enough to comfortably accommodate a dining table, making it the natural hub for everyday meals and social gatherings. A convenient downstairs cloakroom adds to the ease of day-to-day family life. Upstairs, the home continues to impress with three well-proportioned bedrooms. The master bedroom benefits from a sleek en-suite shower room, while the remaining bedrooms are served by a luxury family bathroom, finished to a high standard. Adding further future potential, the property boasts a larger-than-average loft, offering exciting scope for conversion (subject to the necessary planning consents). Outside of the home, the lifestyle on offer is equally appealing. Secure gated parking for two vehicles provides peace of mind, while the surrounding area is rich with natural beauty. Open woodland, nature trails, and the tranquil Burgh Heath pond are quite literally on your doorstep, alongside a nearby fishing lake that’s popular with local residents. Tadworth Leisure Centre is also close by, catering to fitness and recreational needs, and the area is well served by highly regarded primary and secondary schools. Offered to the market chain free, this is a home that combines modern convenience, future potential, and an enviable setting — ideal for families seeking both tranquillity and quality living. The kitchen, living & dining room at the rear is home to a Neptune kitchen with range cooker, utility room and double doors opening on to the South-East facing garden. The first floor is home to bedrooms 1 and 2, both which feature stylish en-suites and dressing rooms. Esher High Street has an extensive selection of places to eat and drink, along with a Waitrose supermarket and Everyman cinema. Nearby Kingston-upon-Thames provides an even greater array of shopping outlets and eateries. Green space and places of interest are in abundance, including National Trust Claremont Gardens and Hampton Court Palace, both close by. For commuter convenience regular trains from Esher railway station to London Waterloo take around 25-30 minutes. results.summary: Charles Eden are proud to offer this delightful and beautifully presented four bedroom Victorian terraced home, ideally located on the sought after Mackenzie Road in Beckenham. Inside, an inviting entrance hall provides access to a downstairs cloakroom and useful under stair storage, before leading through to a bright and elegant living room, complete with plantation shutters, a feature fireplace, and hardwood flooring. A few steps down reveal a spacious open plan kitchen set on a lower level, featuring modern blue cabinetry, fully fitted with integrated appliances including Neff oven, hob and microwave, perfectly suited to both everyday living and entertaining. Just off the kitchen is a practical utility room. The kitchen opens directly onto a beautifully maintained mature garden, partly decked and partly turfed, ideal for enjoying afternoon and evening sun. To the rear is a versatile garden office with electricity, as well as a separate shed for storage. The first floor comprises three well proportioned bedrooms and a family bathroom. The second floor hosts an impressive principal suite, featuring an en suite bathroom, eaves storage and a Juliet balcony. The property is superbly located for families, with a number of well regarded schools nearby including Churchfields Primary, Harris Kent House primary, Stewart Fleming Primary and Alexandra Infant School, with buyers advised to check catchment proximity. The area continues to grow in popularity, with a vibrant and strong community spirit, in an increasingly trendy local scene including El Molino’s restaurant and the nearby BR3WERY taproom. A wonderful blend of period charm and modern convenience, this home is perfectly suited for families seeking space, style and connectivity. results.summary: A truly distinguished five/six-bedroom Victorian residence, spanning approximately 2,600 sq ft across four beautifully curated floors. Commanding an elegant presence on one of Hackney’s most desirable tree-lined streets, this exceptional home strikes a perfect balance between period grandeur and contemporary family living. Rich in character, the property showcases an array of exquisite original features, including statement fireplaces with intricate mosaic detailing, sash windows, stained glass, polished wood flooring, and beautifully preserved balustrades. The principal reception room is nothing short of impressive—defined by its grand proportions, soaring ceilings, and a striking bay window that floods the space with natural light. A second reception room offers further flexibility, equally suited to refined entertaining or more relaxed day-to-day living. To the rear, the home opens into a spectacular kitchen and dining space—generous in scale and designed as the true social heart of the house. Bathed in light and seamlessly connected to a mature west-facing garden, it’s a setting perfectly tailored for both vibrant gatherings and quiet evenings alike. The lower ground floor introduces a superbly appointed guest suite, complete with its own private entrance and en suite—ideal as a nanny suite, studio, or independent living space. Upstairs, the sense of space continues with five beautifully proportioned bedrooms. The principal bedroom is particularly noteworthy, spanning the full width of the house and enhanced by an elegant bay window, creating a luxurious and tranquil retreat. Additional bedrooms are served by a stylish family bathroom, separate shower room, and further WCs, ensuring both comfort and practicality. Having been lovingly held within the same family for over two decades, this is a rare opportunity to acquire a home of genuine substance, style, and long-term appeal. results.summary: From the practical entrance porch—ideal for storing coats, shoes, and umbrellas—to the covered patio overlooking the garden, this home offers well-planned living space. On arrival, you are welcomed by low-maintenance, paved off-street parking. Inside, an L-shaped layout combines the entrance hall and dining area, creating a sociable open-plan feel. The sitting room sits at the front of the property, while an extended kitchen lies to the rear, with both spaces featuring glass bifolding doors that allow for flexible living—perfect for separating areas when desired, whether to contain cooking aromas or enjoy a quieter retreat. The rear extension, completed in 2014, introduced a contemporary kitchen fitted with integrated appliances including a dishwasher, oven, and hob. A breakfast bar enhances both storage and functionality, while also providing casual seating for everyday dining. The ground floor is further complemented by a convenient cloakroom. Upstairs, the first floor comprises two well-presented double bedrooms, each benefiting from built-in storage, alongside a generous single bedroom and a modern family bathroom. The loft was converted in 2024, creating an impressive fourth bedroom accompanied by a stylish shower room. Externally, the rear garden is neatly arranged with a covered patio area, a lawn, and a garage to the rear complete with power and additional storage. Recent improvements include a full rewire in 2024 and replacement windows in 2026—enhancements that will undoubtedly appeal to prospective buyers. Situated on Egham Crescent, the property enjoys a convenient location close to highly regarded schools, excellent transport links, and a range of local amenities. Well-rated schools nearby include Cheam Park Farm Primary Academy, St Cecilia's Catholic Primary School, Glenthorne High School, and Cheam High School. Regular bus routes provide easy access to Cheam, Sutton, Worcester Park and their respective train stations, as well as Morden Underground station. Within walking distance are Aldi, a Tesco/Esso Express, and a variety of independent eateries, while Sainsbury's and the wider selection of shops and restaurants in North Cheam are just a short drive away. Please take some time to study our 2D and 3D landscape floor plans and to browse through our photographs. This spacious home is sure to gain loads of interest so to secure a booking please contact EweMove Cheam and Sutton 24/7 by telephone or online. results.summary: Situated on the 3rd & 4th floor of the unique and private gated Victorian school conversion Mulberry Court located in Shadwell. This 3 bed 2 bath, duplex apartment boasts 961sqft (approx) of well appointed living space. On the 3rd floor, you’ll find a bright open-plan kitchen/living area, complete with integrated appliances and complemented by sash double-glazed windows throughout. The versatile third bedroom can also be found on this floor, boasting a striking west-facing double-height window, this impressive space is currently styled as a study/office. The main bathroom completes the 3rd floor. The 4th floor comprises the primary bedroom, complete with a modern three-piece ensuite. Skylights flood the room with natural light, creating a bright and airy atmosphere. Opposite, the secondary bedroom features built-in wardrobes as well as plenty of dual eaves providing ample storage space. Mulberry Court enjoys a peaceful, off-street setting while being exceptionally well connected. Shadwell Station (DLR and East London Line) and Tower Hill (Circle and District Lines) are just moments away, providing quick access across London. Whitechapel Station (Elizabeth Line) and Shoreditch High Street are also within easy reach, linking you directly to Brick Lane, Spitalfields, and the City. The property is surrounded by a vibrant mix of shops, cafés, bars, and restaurants along Commercial Road, as well as the waterside attractions of Wapping and St Katherine’s Dock. Here, you’ll find some of London’s most historic riverside pubs, including The Prospect of Whitby, The Captain Kidd, and The Town of Ramsgate, all perfect for soaking up the area’s unique character. results.summary: Set behind a handsome white stucco façade on one of South Kensington's best-known terraces, this substantial freehold building extends to approximately 8,670 sq ft and comprises eight self-contained apartments arranged from the lower ground to the fifth floor. Recently refurbished and served by a lift, it combines the stature of a Grade II listed building with clean, contemporary interiors throughout. The building makes an immediate impression from the street, where Queen's Gate Terrace is defined by its run of grand stucco-fronted houses, tall sash windows and classical detailing. Behind the façade, the apartments have been thoughtfully arranged to maximise light and usability, while retaining the proportions and character expected of a house of this scale. At lower-ground level, one of the largest apartments is centred around a generous kitchen and reception space, alongside a bedroom suite and additional dining or living area. Two private patios bring natural light into the plan, while a wine cellar, utility room, vault and plant space add a rare depth of ancillary accommodation. The ground and first floors introduce particularly impressive proportions, with high ceilings, decorative cornicing, marble fireplaces and full-height windows. A first-floor balcony extends the principal reception space, giving these apartments a strong sense of volume and presence. Modern kitchens have been integrated with restraint, allowing the period features to take focus. Upper floors are arranged as a series of well-executed one and two-bedroom apartments, each finished in a contemporary style. Bedrooms are generous, many with fitted storage, and several apartments enjoy open rooftop outlooks. At the top of the building, a further apartment sits beneath the eaves, with additional storage neatly incorporated. Throughout, the interiors are consistent and considered: wooden floors, modern kitchens, well-appointed bathrooms and an abundance of natural light, all set against a backdrop of original detailing. This is a rare freehold opportunity with broad appeal. It lends itself naturally to investment, whether for long-term rental or serviced accommodation, while also offering scope for future reconfiguration, subject to the usual consents. Queen's Gate Terrace sits in the heart of South Kensington, moments from Gloucester Road and within easy reach of Hyde Park, Kensington Gardens and the museums of Exhibition Road. The surrounding streets are defined by their architectural elegance, while some of London's best restaurants, cultural institutions and garden squares are all within walking distance. results.summary: Set within a former industrial building of real architectural presence, this refined loft style apartment occupies the first floor of The Powerhouse, a handsome historic structure converted in 2018 into a small collection of high quality homes. The building sits quietly within the Harrow on the Hill village Conservation Area, moments from open fields and the historic heart of the village. The apartment is defined by volume, light and materiality. Grand arched windows run along the principal elevation, drawing in generous natural light while offering a subtle reference to the building’s industrial origins. The dual aspect open plan living space forms the centre of the home, carefully proportioned to accommodate living and dining, with a fully fitted contemporary kitchen integrated seamlessly into the room. Timber flooring runs through much of the apartment, reinforcing the sense of cohesion and calm. There are two genuine double bedrooms, both quietly positioned and well balanced in scale. A sleek contemporary bathroom sits off the central hallway, finished with restraint and clarity. Throughout, the apartment is presented in exceptional decorative order, with gas fired central heating, video entry system and the reassurance of lift access within the building. Outside, the building is set back from the street in a peaceful position adjacent to Church Fields, providing immediate access to open green space. An allocated parking space adds further practicality, while the station is reached via a short walk across the fields, offering swift connections to the City. Less than twenty minutes from Central London by train, Harrow on the Hill remains one of north west London’s most distinctive village settings, defined by its architecture, community atmosphere and a well curated selection of independent cafés, restaurants and public houses. results.location: Bedford Road, South Tottenahm, London, N15
results.summary: Positioned on Bedford Road, the neighbourhood's most desirable residential street and set within the Clyde Circus Conservation Area, this three-bedroom home occupies the ground and first floors of a handsome Victorian villa. It unfolds with the scale and presence of a house, with its own private entrance and a notably generous entrance hall that sets an assured first impression. To the right, a beautifully proportioned reception room celebrates its period bones with original timber floors underfoot, elegant picture rails, ornate coving and a ceiling rose that anchors the space. It's a room made for slow evenings and soft light. Beyond, the home opens into a generous kitchen-diner - a sociable space to host family and friends. The kitchen is finished with contemporary handleless cabinets and softened by wood worktops. From here, doors lead directly out to a remarkable garden in excess of 60 ft, thoughtfully divided into three distinct zones: a paved patio for long lunches, a central lawn, and a productive vegetable patch tucked away at the rear. Upstairs, the accommodation is generous and well-balanced, with two comfortable double bedrooms, a single bedroom ideal as a child's room or study, and a family bathroom completing the floor. A rare combination of period character, private outdoor space and true house-like proportions - all wrapped within a classic Victorian setting. South Tottenham is a neighbourhood in quiet transition - grounded, culturally rich and increasingly defined by its independent spirit. Long-established communities sit alongside a growing wave of creatives, young families and restaurateurs, giving the area an energy that feels both authentic and forward-looking. Coffee culture plays a central role in daily life here. Independent cafés are woven into the rhythm of the neighbourhood, acting as informal meeting points as much as places to refuel. With Milk is a standout, while Gefsi Coffee House has become a local institution, known for its warm atmosphere and carefully sourced brews. These are the kinds of places where routines form quickly and names are remembered. Food and drink further anchor the area?s evolving identity. Forks & Green Brasserie offers a relaxed, neighbourhood approach to seasonal dining, while Yard Sale Pizza brings its cult following south with informal, reliably great pizzas that suit the area's unfussy charm. The Palm remains a local constant - a proper pub with a loyal crowd, while True Craft Tottenham adds a more contemporary note, blending craft beer with an easy, social atmosphere. For something quieter and more refined, Pasero offers a considered dining experience that reflects the neighbourhood's growing confidence. Green space is another quiet luxury of the area. Downhills Park and Lordship Recreation Ground provide everyday breathing room close to home. Leisure and culture are equally well served. Tottenham Green Leisure Centre provides everyday amenities - from gym and swimming facilities to badminton courts - while Bernie Grant Arts Centre continues to play a vital role in local cultural life, championing performance, exhibitions and community-led events. Connectivity underpins it all. Seven Sisters station offers swift access via the Victoria line and Weaver Line, while nearby Tottenham Hale station connects to national rail services, including direct links to Stansted Airport and Stratford. Together, they reinforce South Tottenham's appeal as a place that feels well-rooted yet effortlessly connected - practical, creative and quietly self-assured. High ceilings and cornicing lend a sense of proportion, while a restrained palette allows the original architecture to take the lead. The reception room is bright and composed. A serving hatch to the rear frames views of the kitchen, thoughtfully designed with a pared-back approach. Clean-lined cabinetry, stone worktops and integrated Siemens, Bosch and Miele appliances keep the space cohesive, with convenient under-cabinet lighting. The bedrooms are arranged with privacy in mind, both with considered storage and neutral schemes. In the bathroom, marbled porcelain tiling wraps the space, complemented by a dual shower system and underfloor heating. A separate laundry room, intercom system and access to the private residents’ garden complete the picture. Bayswater is evolving with quiet confidence. Queen’s Gardens sits at the centre of it all. Hyde Park is moments away, while nearby Westbourne Grove and Notting Hill bring a mix of boutiques, galleries and destination dining. results.summary: This property is offered for sale using the Reservation fee process. Reservation fee is a new, innovative and pioneering process for buying and selling property. It significantly reduces the risk of gazumping or double-selling by offering security to both parties by gaining a commitment from both parties to buy and sell. When an offer is accepted, the buyer will be required to make payment of a non-refundable Reservation Fee of 1.8% of the purchase price including VAT (in addition to the final negotiated selling price). This is subject to a minimum amount of £6,600 including VAT. This will secure the transaction and the property will be taken off the market. The purchaser will not be exchanging contracts but will be given 90 working days in which to complete the transaction, from the date the Draft Contract is received by the buyer’s solicitor (or 10 working days after receipt of the Reservation Fee, whichever is earlier). The buyer will also be required to pay a legal pack fee of £396 including VAT and to sign the Reservation Form and agree the Terms and Conditions prior to solicitors being instructed. If you require a copy of these documents, or for further information, please contact the Reservation Fee team at GOTO Group. Buyer Fees: • The Reservation fee and legal pack fee are in addition to the final negotiated selling price. • Stamp Duty Land Tax (SDLT) is applicable if you buy a property or land over a certain price in England, Wales or Northern Ireland. results.summary: Situated on the third floor of a centrally located purpose-built block, this spacious two-bedroom apartment offers well-balanced living accommodation, ideal for both first-time buyers and investors alike. The property comprises a generously sized reception room, a separate fitted kitchen, two double bedrooms, a family bathroom, and a separate WC. Offered to the market with no onward chain, this apartment presents an excellent opportunity for those seeking a comfortable home or a strong rental investment. Blaxland House is ideally positioned just a short walk from the vibrant heart of Shepherd’s Bush, offering an extensive selection of shops, cafés, bars, and restaurants, as well as the renowned Westfield London shopping centre. Excellent transport links are available nearby, including White City Station (Central Line) and Shepherd’s Bush Market (Hammersmith & City Line). results.summary: Occupying arguably one of the finest positions within this contemporary apartment block, with double aspect windows that bathe the interior in natural light throughout the day, The Personal Agent are delighted to present this beautifully refurbished one bedroom apartment. Lovingly updated by the current owner, the flat now enjoys a stylish new shower room, contemporary flooring and upgraded lighting, creating a fresh, modern feel that perfectly complements its already impressive layout. The result is a turnkey home designed for comfort, ease and effortless living. Offered with no ongoing chain and set within the highly sought after Noble Park on the edge of Horton Country Park, this home offers an enviable lifestyle. Hundreds of acres of ancient woodland are quite literally on your doorstep, with bridleways and cycle paths linking directly to the Stamford Green conservation area, complete with nature reserve, picturesque duck pond and two welcoming public houses, perfect for weekend walks or relaxed afternoons close to home. Convenience is always within easy reach with Epsom town centre and its array of retail, dining and leisure facilities, as well as the mainline railway station just a short drive away. The David Lloyd leisure centre is also nearby, ensuring a healthy balance between peaceful community living and town accessibility. Stepping through the front door, the sense of space is immediately apparent. A generous entrance hallway with built-in storage sets the tone for the well-proportioned accommodation beyond. The impressive 17ft x 15ft living/dining room flows seamlessly into the separate kitchen area, creating defined yet connected spaces that are ideal for entertaining, socialising, or simply unwinding at the end of the day. The modern open plan arrangement enhances the natural light and makes everyday living feel effortless. A south facing Juliette balcony extends the main reception space, inviting in the sunshine and offering a charming spot to enjoy a morning coffee or evening breeze. The accommodation is completed by a generous double bedroom with a bright southerly aspect, the newly refurbished shower room finished to a contemporary standard, and the practical benefits of covered allocated parking beneath a carport. Residents of Roberts Court also enjoy access to a secure communal bike storage unit. This is a home that combines style, setting and lifestyle thoughtfully improved and ready to be enjoyed. Epsom is a charming town that strikes a lovely balance between countryside tranquillity and everyday convenience with its leafy streets sitting alongside a vibrant town centre. Here you’ll find the Ashley Centre shopping mall, a twice weekly traditional market, independent cafés and restaurants making it ideal for families and professionals seeking both character and convenience. For leisure, there are plenty of green spaces including Horton Country Park with its adventure farm and nature trails, Epsom Common, and the iconic Epsom Downs Racecourse all providing a backdrop for weekend walks, bike rides or simply relaxing outdoors. Transport links are excellent for both commuters and adventurers. Epsom station has frequent direct services into London to Victoria, Waterloo and beyond with journey times roughly 35-45 minutes. By road, the town offers fast access to the M25 and A3, making travel into London or further afield easy. When it comes to airports, Heathrow is around a 35-minute drive away and Gatwick about the same offering international travel without the stress of a long journey. results.summary: Rosindale Pavitt Estate Agents are delighted to offer this attractive three-bedroom semi-detached home, located on one of Wallington’s most desirable residential roads. This property offers a fantastic opportunity for new owners to move straight in, while still providing the flexibility to add their own personal touch with minimal additional expense. Further benefiting from No Onward Chain, it presents an ideal purchase for those seeking a straight forward move. Upon entering the property, you are welcomed by a spacious entrance hallway that leads through to the bright front reception room. This inviting space features a large bay window to the front allowing plenty of natural light to fill the room and create a bright, airy feel. To the rear of the property is the dining room, which enjoys pleasant views over the garden and benefits from French doors that create a seamless connection between indoor and outdoor living. Adjacent to the dining room is the well-appointed kitchen, fitted with an oven, and a four-ring gas hob with extractor above. There is also space for dishwasher. Upstairs, the first floor offers three well-proportioned bedrooms and a family bathroom. The principal bedroom features a large bay window, mirroring the reception room below. The family bathroom comprises a bath with shower over and a wash basin, with a useful linen cupboard for storage. Loft access is available via a hatch on the landing. The rear garden is mainly laid to lawn with a patio area directly behind the house, providing an excellent space for outdoor dining and entertaining. The level layout makes the garden particularly easy to maintain. To the front, the paved driveway offers off-street parking for several vehicles and leads to an attached garage, providing additional parking or useful storage space. This home is ideally positioned for families, with access to several highly regarded local grammar schools including Wallington Boys, Wallington Girls, Wilson’s, and St Philomena’s. The property is conveniently located close to local bus routes and is just 0.7 miles from Wallington Station, offering excellent transport links. These initial checks are carried out on our behalf by Lifetime Legal who will contact you once you have had an offer accepted on a property you wish to buy. The cost of these checks is £72 (incl. This fee will need to be paid by you in advance of us issuing a memorandum of sale, directly to Lifetime Legal, and is non-refundable. results.summary: Nestled on the ever popular Burleigh Road, a highly regarded residential street in the heart of Bush Hill Park, this sizeable three bedroom 1930s end terrace home presents a wonderful opportunity for families seeking space, character, and convenience. Positioned within close reach of a wide selection of local shops and amenities, the property is ideally situated for access to Enfield Town Centre, where an array of restaurants, cafes, and retail options await. Commuters will appreciate the excellent transport connections nearby, with local bus routes and Enfield Town Station offering direct services into the City. For families, the home sits comfortably within the catchment area for some of Enfield’s most sought-after schools, including George Spicer Primary and Bush Hill Park Primary. The accommodation offers a welcoming sense of space throughout. A generously sized through lounge provides flexible living and dining areas, ideal for both everyday comfort and entertaining. The kitchen/diner to the rear is well-appointed and perfectly suited for family mealtimes and gatherings. Upstairs, the property continues to impress with three well proportioned bedrooms, two of which feature built-in wardrobes, along with a three piece shower room. A particular highlight of this home is the expansive rear garden, stretching approximately 60 feet and mainly laid to lawn a fantastic space for children to play, outdoor dining, or future landscaping projects. Additional benefits include a garage to the side, offering both storage and potential for further development. results.summary: Occupying the ground and lower ground floors of a converted Victorian house is this well presented four-bedroom split level flat. With approximately 1,679 sq ft of living space, the flat boasts excellent proportions-throughout, a principal suite and an excellent private garden. The attractive double reception room has grand Victorian proportions with a large bay window, wooden flooring, an original Victorian fireplace and built-in shelving and cabinetry. A superb kitchen family room is situated to the back of the property with handless white wall and base units, integrated appliances, granite work surfaces, a breakfast bar and ample space for a large dining table. Bi-folding doors to the rear provide natural light to the room and leads out to the private garden. Laid with easi-grass some raised garden beds with mature planting, it is the ideal spot for alfresco eating and entertaining in the warmer months. The ground floor is completed with a downstairs WC and access to the lightwell providing the perfect space to store bikes. Three double bedrooms, a family bathroom and the principal suite are all arranged on the lower ground floor. The principal suite benefits from French doors leading out into the lightwell, a walk-though dressing room with bespoke wardrobes which leads through to the en suite shower room. An additional three double bedrooms can also be found on this level, one double bedroom benefits from an en suite shower room, built-in wardrobes and access to a lightwell. The further two double bedrooms located to the rear and are both wonderfully bright thanks to the shared lightwell which are both accessible via French doors and laid with easi-grass. A spacious family bathroom with a walk-in shower and bath completes the accommodation. Almeric Road is just off Battersea Rise, just a stone throws away from Northcote Road with all its shops, restaurants and bars. Transport can be found at Clapham Junction Overground, approximately a five-minute walk away, and the wide-open spaces of both Wandsworth Common and Clapham Common are within easy reach. A number of popular state and private schools are nearby, subject to catchment and places each year. results.summary: Oaks Estate Agents are delighted to present this beautifully renovated five-bedroom family home, ideally located on the ever-popular Ashburton Avenue. Finished to an exceptional standard throughout by the current owners, this impressive property offers approximately 1,930 sq. ft. of stylish and contemporary living space, perfectly suited to modern family life. The accommodation comprises five generously sized bedrooms, including two spacious doubles within a superb loft conversion, both benefiting from excellent head height and served by a large, well-appointed bathroom. The first floor hosts three further substantial bedrooms and a sleek family bathroom, complete with a stunning walk in shower. The ground floor is a true highlight of the home, featuring underfloor heating throughout, a bright and elegant front reception room, and an outstanding open plan kitchen and dining area. Ashburton Avenue is perfectly positioned for commuters, with East Croydon station within easy reach, providing fast and direct services to London Victoria and London Bridge, as well as connections to Gatwick Airport and Brighton. results.summary: Guide price £580,000 to £600,000. A Spacious 1930s 4 bedroom Extended Family Home in a Highly Sought-After Turning Positioned within one of the most desirable turnings in Chadwell Heath, this extended 1930s terraced home offers generous and versatile accommodation arranged over three floors, making it an ideal purchase for growing families seeking space, convenience and a strong community setting. Havering Gardens is particularly popular with family buyers thanks to its attractive period homes and excellent connectivity. The property is located within easy reach of Chadwell Heath railway station, now served by the Elizabeth Line, providing fast and direct access into central London. For leisure time, families can enjoy nearby green spaces such as Valentines Park and Goodmayes Park, both ideal for weekend walks, playground visits and outdoor activities. A range of local shops, cafés and everyday amenities are close at hand along the High Road, with more extensive shopping and entertainment facilities available in Romford. The area is also well regarded for its choice of primary and secondary schools, further enhancing its appeal to families. The property itself is an attractive 1930s terraced house set behind a smart block-paved front driveway providing valuable off-street parking. Upon entering, you are welcomed by a bright entrance hallway featuring solid oak flooring, stairs rising to the upper floors and a useful storage cupboard beneath. Just off the hallway is a convenient ground floor WC with wash basin, an increasingly essential feature for modern family living. To the front of the home is a generously sized living room with a large bay window allowing plenty of natural light to flood the space. Sliding doors lead through to the second reception room, which has been extended to the rear to create a substantial family room. This impressive space benefits from patio doors opening directly onto the garden and features a pitched, tiled roof over the rear extension, adding character and enhancing the sense of height and light. The long galley-style kitchen with skylight window and access to garden has also been extended and offers a comprehensive range of wall and base units, an integrated oven and hob, and ample space for additional appliances, providing a practical and well-designed environment for busy family life. On the first floor, there is a very good-sized front double bedroom with bay window, a further generous double bedroom overlooking the rear, and a well-proportioned third bedroom ideal as a child’s room, nursery or home office. The family bathroom is well presented and comprises a bath, wash basin and WC. The second floor loft conversion creates an excellent-sized double bedroom with built-in wardrobes and extensive eaves storage. Leading off is a contemporary en-suite shower room featuring a corner shower, wash basin, WC and rear-facing window. From this elevated position, the property enjoys far-reaching views to the rear. There is a pressurised boiler system in the loft providing excellent water pressure throughout. Outside, the rear garden has been thoughtfully arranged for both relaxation and recreation. A raised decking area provides a pleasant seating space for entertaining, with steps leading down to a lawn bordered by flowers and shrubs. A pathway leads to the rear of the garden where a substantial shed/outbuilding is located, complete with power, lighting and its own fuse box, making it suitable for storage, a workshop or hobby space. The property further benefits from secure gated rear pedestrian access, offering additional practicality and peace of mind. Offering spacious accommodation, thoughtful extensions, off-street parking and a prime location close to transport links, parks, shops and schools, Havering Gardens presents a superb opportunity for families looking to establish themselves in this highly sought-after part of Chadwell Heath. All representations contained in the particulars are based on details supplied by the Seller. Your Conveyancer is legally responsible for ensuring any purchase agreement fully protects your position. results.summary: Situated on the desirable Windsor Drive in EN4, this beautifully presented home offers approximately 1,491 sq ft (138.6 sq m) of well-planned accommodation arranged over three floors. Immaculately maintained throughout, the property is in true turnkey condition, making it ideal for buyers seeking a stylish and ready-to-move-into home. The ground floor is thoughtfully laid out, featuring a welcoming entrance hallway leading to a bright and comfortable reception room at the front of the property. To the rear, a stunning open-plan kitchen and dining space forms the heart of the home, providing a perfect setting for everyday living and entertaining, with direct access to the garden. A convenient utility room and guest cloakroom complete this level, enhancing practicality. The first floor offers a well-balanced arrangement of bedrooms, all accessed from a central landing, alongside a modern family bathroom. The proportions are ideal for family living, with flexible space for children's rooms, guests, or a home office if required. Occupying the top floor, the second floor provides a generous additional bedroom suite, complete with its own bathroom, creating a private retreat, perfect as a principal suite or for visiting guests. Externally, the property benefits from a well-maintained rear garden, complete with a useful shed for storage, as well as off-street parking to the front, adding to the home's overall convenience. LOCATION Situated on a quiet residential street, 33 Windsor Drive, EN4 enjoys a highly desirable location in the heart of Barnet. The property benefits from a peaceful suburban setting while remaining conveniently close to a range of local amenities, including shops, cafes, and well-regarded schools. Excellent transport links are easily accessible, with nearby rail and underground stations providing direct routes into Central London, making it ideal for commuters. The area is also well served by local bus routes and major road connections, offering straightforward access to surrounding towns and the M25. Residents can take advantage of nearby green spaces and parks, perfect for outdoor activities and family life. The neighbourhood is known for its friendly community atmosphere, combining the charm of a residential area with the practicality of urban convenience. Overall, this location offers a perfect balance of tranquillity, connectivity, and everyday convenience. Freehold Council tax - Band E EPC - C MESSAGE FROM THE OWNERS We have absolutely loved our time here on Windsor Drive. When we first moved in, we wanted to keep the original character of the 1930s build but completely update it for the way we actually live today. We put a lot of heart into the renovation and the extension, creating a bright, open space that genuinely just feels like home. Opening up the back of the house to the landscaped garden in the summer has been one of our favorite things, it's such a peaceful, private spot to just sit and unwind after a busy day. It's going to be really hard to leave the neighborhood, too. The commute into London is incredibly easy, which has been brilliant for work, but the weekends here are what we'll miss the most. Having the park practically on the doorstep is amazing for getting outdoors and getting some fresh air. We also love just wandering down into the village on a Sunday morning for a coffee, or heading to one of the cozy local spots for dinner. It has such a lovely, welcoming community feel to it. This house has been a genuinely happy place for us, and we really hope whoever moves in next loves living here just as much as we have. results.summary: Highlever Road is resolutely residential. Tree-lined, well spaced and settled, it’s a fitting setting for families and those seeking a quieter city setting. Behind its Victorian façade, this four-bedroom home has been thoughtfully refurbished: period features retain their foothold, while a contemporary extension introduces flow and flexibility. Elegant and well arranged, the reception room welcomes with a swathe of neutral tones. Original ornaments come into their own here: generous proportions are adorned with intricate plasterwork and brightened by a large bay window that looks out to the manicured front garden. It’s a room that can flex easily, with a natural continuation into the snug beyond. Note the internal window – an elevated sightline through the kitchen to the garden beyond. To the rear, the house opens up dramatically. A kitchen and dining space stretches outward beneath skylights, where daylight filters down throughout the day. Contemporary cabinetry and a generous island create a sociable hub, while wide glazing connects the interior to the garden. Outside, the west-facing patio extends the living space into the open air. Upstairs, four bedrooms are arranged across the top two floors. The principal bedroom enjoys a sense of privacy and proportion, with built-in wardrobes and a balcony. Its en suite is streamlined and sophisticated, with a walk-in rainfall shower. Three further bedrooms are well-sized and versatile – suited to family life, guests or working from home. There’s a welcoming, laid-back feel to North Kensington. Within walking distance of both Golborne and Portobello Road, an array of independent businesses await on the doorstep. Shop for supplies at Golborne Deli & Wine Store, book lunch at Straker’s or enjoy pastries to go from Lisboa. Spend weekends browsing the neighbourhood’s renowned antique and vintage stalls. results.summary: This attractive six bedroom detached house has been modernised and decorated to create a contemporary and luxurious home. Positioned in one of Theydon's favourite roads you're close to the central line station, schools, independent shops, two great pubs and an excellent choice of restaurants. A large, light-filled hallway provides access throughout the ground floor, first of all we're heading to the bright, colourful kitchen and family room, with a central island and plenty of storage. There are views out to the garden and doors to the patio area, leading to the large south-easterly facing garden and fabulous swimming pool/gym complex with sauna, cloakroom and changing room. There is also a separate garden room here with a cloakroom. The ground floor of the house also has a utility room, guest cloakroom and huge split-level living room with raised dining area, a study and bedroom six/playroom with it's own shower-room. Upstairs you'll find the largest of the bedrooms with an amazing dressing room, charming en-suite bathroom and private terrace, with far reaching views across the surrounding countryside and 4 additional double bedrooms and spacious family bathroom. The driveway has plenty of space for your vehicles. The village green, duckpond and playground are nearby as are the tennis and cricket clubs, deer sanctuary and of course Epping Forest. There are fantastic amenities in the village with a Montessori nursery, Theydon Bois Pre and Primary school, two churches both with a calendar of social activities and an amazing village hall with a variety of clubs and societies. Many local senior school-age children attend Debden Park or Davenant and there are pick up points within the village for Hockerill, St Edmunds, St Nicholas & Chigwell Schools. results.summary: Set across the upper floors of a handsome Victorian building on New North Road, this beautifully composed three-bedroom home unfolds vertically, offering over 1,440 sq ft of internal and external space and culminating in a substantial private roof terrace with open skyline views. Arrival is via elegant Portland stone entrance steps, setting a refined architectural tone from the outset. Inside, a solid wood herringbone floor anchors the hallway, immediately establishing warmth and material quality that continues throughout the home. Rather than reading as a conventional apartment, the property presents more like a private house in the sky — layered, light-filled and rich in retained architectural detail. A characterful original staircase connects each level, creating a natural sense of flow and spatial journey through the home. The principal living level is anchored by a generous open-plan kitchen, dining and reception space, where soft colour tones, warm timber floors and period features sit comfortably alongside contemporary joinery and clean-lined detailing. Dual sash windows bring excellent natural light into the space, while exposed brickwork and original fireplaces subtly reinforce the building’s heritage. The hand-built in-frame kitchen is finished with solid oak worktops and integrated Neff appliances, designed for both everyday living and entertaining. Cabinetry is painted and easily adaptable for future owners, while a separate utility and laundry cupboard upstairs keeps the main living spaces uncluttered and refined. The upper sleeping levels provide two well-proportioned bedrooms alongside a beautifully finished family bathroom, creating calm and well-balanced private accommodation. A third room offers excellent flexibility as a guest bedroom, studio or home office. Practical storage has been thoughtfully integrated, including a generous under-stairs cupboard and additional storage at the top of the stairwell. Comfort and performance have been carefully considered throughout. The home benefits from a whole-house ventilation system that continuously introduces fresh air while removing stale air — keeping the property comfortable and well-regulated year-round. Double glazing, new radiators and upgraded insulation beneath the engineered floating floors deliver excellent thermal efficiency and impressive acoustic separation. The electrics were comprehensively renewed in 2019, offering peace of mind for incoming buyers. Crowning the home is an exceptional private roof terrace measuring approximately 341 sq ft — a genuinely usable outdoor room rather than a token balcony. Recently upgraded in 2024 alongside the roof structure, the terrace is fitted with integrated lighting, power and water supply, creating a highly functional space for outdoor dining, entertaining and evening relaxation, with open views stretching across surrounding rooftops toward the City skyline. From a ownership perspective, the building is efficiently managed with no service charge or ground rent. Building insurance is shared between just two freeholders, contributing to low ongoing costs and a well-maintained, cooperative arrangement. Positioned within a Conservation Area, New North Road sits at the intersection of Islington, Shoreditch and the City. Regent’s Canal and Shoreditch Park provide nearby green space, while a vibrant mix of independent cafés, restaurants and neighbourhood shops sit moments from the front door. Excellent transport connections are available via Old Street and Angel stations, alongside multiple bus routes offering fast access across Central and East London. A rare opportunity to acquire a vertically layered Victorian home with meaningful outdoor space, strong architectural character and intelligently upgraded infrastructure in one of North London’s most dynamic neighbourhoods. results.summary: TUDOR AND CO are pleased to offer for sale this deceptively spacious three bedroom semi-detached home which has had the benefit of a stunning rear extension with bi-fold doors opening onto the rear garden and a loft conversion with luxury en-suite shower room. Well cared by the current vendors the property has been updated significantly throughout to a high specification and is an ideal property for a first time buyer or for a young family. Located within easy reach of local shops, primary schools and bus routes connecting West Molesey, East Molesey, Hampton Court (with its Palace, restaurants, boutiques, cafes and train station – ideal for the commuter, Oyster zone 6), Kingston upon Thames (with comprehensive shopping) Hersham village and Walton on Thames (with many shops, leisure centre and cinema). Hurst Park (where you can enjoy walks by the River Thames) and Bushy Royal Park – With over 1000 acres are also nearby. East Molesey cricket club, Molesey Rowing club, Molesey sailing club, Molesey football club, Hurst swimming Pool and the soon to be David Lloyds gym offer lots of sporting activities including tennis courts and a swimming pool. The property comprises; an extended entrance porch with composite front door with ample room for hanging coats and storing shoes, a hallway with door that opens onto a light and spacious living room with engineered Oak flooring which widens into a play area for children with the benefit of a side and front aspect windows. The 18ft living room leads onto a stunning extended 18ft kitchen/dining room which enjoys plenty of space for a dining room with the benefit of a glass roof lantern/skylight and bi-fold doors that open onto the garden. The kitchen has many eye/base level units/cupboards with granite worktops and a smart breakfast bar along with an integrated dishwasher and space for range gas hob with oven and American style fridge/freezer. A door from the kitchen leads to a multi-functioning garage/workshop/utility room with door leading to the front and rear garden and a separate WC. Stairs from the hallway lead up to a landing with access to two generous bedrooms and a bathroom with WC, sink and bath suite. Further turning stairs lead to a landing with access to an impressive loft conversion with a large 18ft master bedroom with office space and a separate shower room with WC and sink. Externally there the rear garden is mainly laid to lawn with two decking areas, along with a timber summer house at the end of the garden. To the front there is a long driveway providing off road parking for two cars. Other benefits include; double-glazing, gas central heating and the entire ground floor level of the property has a ‘WET’ underfloor heating system. (EPC rating: C) Elmbridge Borough Council tax band = C. Tudor & Co. results.summary: A charming one-bedroom apartment set within the highly sought-after Denman House, a distinguished private development on the tree-lined Lordship Terrace. Constructed in 1937 by the Church Commissioners, this well-regarded block is considered one of Stoke Newington’s most desirable addresses, ideally positioned just moments from the vibrant amenities of Church Street and a short walk from the open green spaces of Clissold Park. Positioned on the second floor, the property offers well-balanced accommodation and an abundance of natural light throughout. The bright and spacious reception room provides an inviting living space, complemented by a separate fitted kitchen with ample storage and modern appliances. The double bedroom is well-proportioned, while the bathroom is arranged as a clean and functional three-piece suite comprising bath, wash hand basin and WC. The apartment retains a sense of character with attractive parquet flooring, while offering a comfortable and practical layout suited to both owner-occupiers and investors alike. Denman House is superbly located just seconds from the ever-popular Stoke Newington Church Street, renowned for its array of independent cafés, restaurants and boutiques. Clissold Park is within easy reach, offering expansive green space, tennis courts and leisure facilities. Transport links are excellent, with Stoke Newington Overground station providing swift access to Liverpool Street, alongside numerous bus routes connecting to the City and West End. Spanning approximately 420 sq. ft., the property features a bright and inviting open-plan reception and kitchen space, thoughtfully designed to maximise both comfort and functionality. The contemporary fitted kitchen is sleek and well-appointed, seamlessly blending into the living area, perfect for relaxing or entertaining. results.summary: Frost Estate Agents are delighted to bring to the market this generous detached family home - CHAIN FREE - Five Double Bedrooms - Two Bathrooms - Ample Parking and Garage - Spacious Living Areas A welcoming entrance hall sets the tone for the property, providing access to the principal ground floor rooms, with stairs rising to the first floor and useful understairs storage and guest WC. While functional, this space offers clear scope for enhancement to create a brighter and more contemporary first impression. To the front, a generously proportioned reception room benefits from a wide window that draws in plenty of natural light. Its impressive size provides an excellent foundation for a stylish and comfortable living area. Positioned to the rear, the dining room enjoys views over the garden and sits conveniently alongside the kitchen, making it ideal for both everyday family life and entertaining. The ground floor is further complemented by a spacious attached garage, ideal for secure parking or storage, with potential for conversion into additional living accommodation, subject to the usual consents. Upstairs, the property continues to impress with well-proportioned accommodation. The principal bedroom is particularly generous, offering ample wardrobes, and presents an excellent opportunity to create a comfortable and stylish retreat. Four further bedrooms provide flexibility for family living, guests, or home working, each offering good proportions and scope for updating. A family bathroom and separate shower room serve the first floor (one en-suite to the principal bedroom). Outside, the property boasts a rear garden, mainly laid to lawn, providing a wonderful outdoor space with plenty of room for landscaping or extension, subject to planning permission. The location is ultra-convenient with Purley Station a short 8-10 minute walk away. You can take your pick from Victoria or London Bridge as destinations – both around 25 minutes’ travel time, the Thameslink Route provides access to Farringdon and City. Alternatively, Gatwick Airport is just 26 minutes in the other direction. Road links are excellent too. The A23 is minutes away and provides fast, easy access to London, the South Coast and the M25. Purley and its surrounding area is known for many excellent state and private schools locally, which include the John Fisher School - a high-performing Catholic all boys state school, Laleham Lea Primary School - a co-educational prep-school, Oakwood School - a co-educational Catholic primary and Riddlesdown Collegiate. Others include Wallington Girls, Whitgift, Wilsons, Christchurch and Beaumont. The area has many local health and leisure clubs, recreation grounds and other destinations including the wide-open spaces of Riddlesdown Common, Kenley Common and the recreational facilities of Kenley Airfield. For convenience, There is a large Tesco superstore opposite the property, more extensive retail and leisure options can be found along the Purley Way, including Valley Park. results.summary: We are delighted to offer to the market this stunning five bedroom detached family home, in exceptional condition, with internal accommodation measuring in excess of 3100 sq ft. Located on Heathfield Road, the house sits in the heart of Keston village, a conservation area, adjacent to the Keston ponds, with stunning rural walks from the house, with access to two village pubs, popular coffee shops & a local post office/ village shop. The house itself is secluded and positioned away from Heathfield Road. It is accessed via a five bar gate at the end of a curved driveway that opens to an expansive frontage, comprising of lawns, established trees and flower beds. A block driveway sits in between, with a spacious double garage, with remote electric door, plus parking for many cars. An enclosed entrance porch leads to a double height hallway. Leading off the hallway is a substantial double aspect light filled living room with log burner set in a limestone fireplace. The large dining room leads onto a bespoke recently constructed 25m orangery with an additional wood-burner and underfloor heating. The orangery has sliding doors on all sides that open up to the porcelain patio which wraps around the whole exterior of the house. The professionally landscaped garden is secluded, laid to lawn with established hedges, trees & flower beds. Within the garden there is a shed, wood store & greenhouse. The hallway also leads to; a separate family room; a study, with fitted bookshelves, cupboards & desks for two; a large custom kitchen designed by Jane Cheel Furniture in American Light Oak & painted cabinets. The kitchen benefits from many integrated appliances, granite worktops and an iroko cooking area with sink, a granite breakfast island and a purpose built matching corner dining area. A separate utility room leads off the kitchen, with plenty of additional storage in matching cabinets & granite work tops. Additionally, there is a cloakroom to the ground floor plus a walk in coat cupboard. The first floor encompasses a large landing with minstrel gallery; with a master bedroom complete with fitted bedroom furniture; a walk in dressing room; and an expansive en-suite bathroom suite, with a large Hans Grohe walk-in shower, Svedberg free-standing bath & double sink unit. There are an additional 4 bedrooms one of which is ensuite, all with built in bedroom furniture. Additionally there is a walk in family shower room. The property has laminated engineered light oak flooring throughout the ground floor & carpet to the upstairs; as well as recently fitted (2024) cast iron radiators to the ground floor & landing, which add to each room’s ambiance. All windows are aluminium & double glazed and were replaced when the Orangery was constructed. Viewing is highly recommended. results.summary: Situated along the distinguished Knoll Road and with accommodation arranged over three floors is this six bedroom detached property. Originally constructed circa 1895 this home almost has too many plus points to note so we will try to highlight what we think are it's best features. The ground floor begins with a prestigious entrance hall, a bay fronted 17'2 dining room, two further reception rooms, a utility room and the kitchen. There is also access to the cellar from the hallway. results.summary: Located just off Honeypot Lane within quarter of a mile of local amenities and half a mile of Queensbury Jubilee Line tube station, this chain-free, semi-detached property comes with a garage via its own driveway and provides generously proportioned living space. This bay-fronted, chain-free, semi-detached residence is positioned within a desirable and popular family-orientated area due to the locality of an array of amenities and well regarded Primary Schools all being within quarter to half a mile radius and Secondary Schools being within a miles radius. The property is presented in good decorative order with generously proportioned living space; however, its new owners may want to re-decorate and re-configure to suit their own personal tastes and requirements. Approached by way of the front garden with its own driveway affording off road parking facilities and continuing to the property’s garage which is set back in the rear garden accessible through gates at the side of the house, the front door opens onto an inviting home. The entrance hall gives access to two separate reception rooms – a front aspect lounge and a rear dining room which benefits from patio doors opening onto a mature and well-maintained rear garden with a patio and lawn areas offering an appealing outdoor space for family gatherings and children to play in. The fitted kitchen is also off the hallway and features wood effect laminate work surfaces and is fitted with a gas hob, extractor hood and fitted gas oven. It also gives additional entry into the rear garden. To the first floor there are two double bedrooms, a single bedroom and a well-designed shower room with a separate w.c. Glebe Avenue is located within less than half a mile of Queensbury's Jubilee Line tube station transporting you to Central London in around 20-25 minutes. There are also bus routes (79, 114 and the 324) along Honeypot Lane which Glebe Avenue is located off. Numerous local shopping amenities, restaurants and cafes can be found at Queensbury and Streatfield Road which are all within quarter of a mile to a half mile radius of the property. Morrison's supermarket is on Honeypot Lane (just over quarter of a mile away) with further supermarkets such as Iceland's, Tesco Express and Aldi being within a mile radius. Both Queensbury Recreation Ground and Woodcock Park are within half a mile of Glebe Avenue and provide sporting and leisure facilities as well as children's playgrounds. There is a good selection of highly regarded schools such as Kenmore Infant, Primary & Junior School, Glebe Primary and St. Bernadette’s Catholic Primary all being within quarter of a mile to a mile and for older children going to Secondary school there is Canon’s High, Claremont High and Kingsbury High. Furthermore, there are various GP/Dental practices, places of worship and gyms within local vicinity. results.summary: This fantastic detached home is set on a highly sought-after road in Petts Wood, conveniently located close to popular primary schools, the station and the town centre. Thoughtfully upgraded and extended by the current owners, the property offers generous and versatile living space throughout. The former garage has been expertly converted into a bright and practical office/gym, ideal for modern family life. A rear extension across both the ground and first floors has created a superb contemporary layout, centred around a stylish German kitchen, a family room with dining area and a separate utility room. The accommodation comprises an entrance hallway, from which there is access to the office/gym and a ground floor shower room with WC. To the front, there is a bright and airy reception room with a large window, while double doors lead through to the impressive kitchen/family space. From here, a door opens to the utility room and bi-fold doors open directly onto the rear garden. Upstairs, there are four well-proportioned bedrooms. The principal bedroom benefits from fitted wardrobes and a spacious en suite bathroom, while the remaining bedrooms are served by a stylish family bathroom (with bath and shower) across the landing. Further benefits include double glazing, gas central heating, and underfloor heating throughout the ground floor. To the front, a large block-paved driveway provides ample off-street parking that is secured with posts and also includes an EV charger. The rear garden enjoys a desirable south-westerly aspect and is predominantly laid to lawn with a generous patio area, ideal for entertaining. results.summary: One bedroom first floor apartment with just one careful owner from new, with a private covered balcony and a long lease. Find your smart 570 sq ft pad within a smart gated development (with communal secure bike store), close to loads of delightful public green spaces, in Forest Hill/East Dulwich borderland. Moonlight Drive rests quietly off Wood Vale - a highly desirable residential street of grand Victorian houses in the main. This low-rise boutique modern development is named 'Prosperous Apartments'. A shared secure-entry main door opens to a well-kept communal hall. Take the stairs to the first floor where you'll find your own front door. From the hall you have a generous coat/cleaning cupboard to your immediate right. Next on your right is the immaculate internal modern bathroom, with contemporary suite and fittings (we love the on-trend monochrome detailing). Next up is your large main room, of nearly 20 feet by over 11 feet (plenty of space to zone dining and seating areas), with a cool exposed brick wall to the reception end. Find your modern kitchen to the opposite end of the room - with neat units in black and white, and integrated appliances (these are included in the sale). Engineered oak impresses to the floor, and as throughout, walls are a crisp white. Huge double-glazed sliding doors deliver you to your private covered balcony. At the end of the hall, find your most-pleasing carpeted double bedroom, of 15 feet by over 9 feet. A bank of built-in (to-the-ceiling) closets sit at the near end. This location is very desirable - leafy, quiet and residential, yet so connected: you are less than 11 minutes by foot from Peckham Rye Park and Common's 113 acres, and 15 minutes from Lordship Lane. The town centres and high streets of Forest Hill and Honor Oak are easily reached by foot, too. More local shops, pubs and cafes are a five minute walk away, on Forest Hill Road. For stations, you've got three to choose from in easy-walking distance: Honor Oak Park (Fare Zone 3), East Dulwich and Peckham Rye (both Zone 2). Day and night bus routes are also at your feet, from Peckham Rye. We've mentioned Peckham Rye Park and Common. There are loads of gorgeous green spaces to call your local ones - Horniman Gardens, Goose Green, One Tree Hill and Dulwich Park are just a handful of examples. In addition to the useful run of shops on Forest Hill Road and Barry Road, more options are on Lordship and Rye Lanes, as well as in Honor Oak, Forest Hill and Nunhead centres. North Cross Road's Saturday market is also local. Our favourite nearby cafes are Cafe G (on the corner of The Gardens), and Cafe On The Rye. For evening social meets? Watson's General Telegraph, The Herne Tavern and The Clockhouse are all top local pubs, in handsome Victorian buildings. Bellenden Road also isn't far for top restaurants including Artusi, Ganapati and The Begging Bowl. Other great dining options in SE15 include Levan, Banh Banh, Mr Bao and Peckham Bazaar. Miss Margherita and Babur in the Honor Oak district are also highly recommended. East Dulwich leisure centre is a short stroll away, or you can 'sign up' for British Military Fitness workouts on Peckham Rye, or join the park-runners for free each Saturday at 9am. results.summary: The Fisheries is a striking modern development in the heart of Hackney’s London Fields, offering a collection of bespoke one, two, and three-bedroom apartments built to a high standard with a nod to warehouse-style living. Amenities include a daytime porter service, covered bike store and access to popular co-working space. Residential parts are accessed via a fob entry system with lifts serving all floors. This upper-floor, dual-aspect apartment offers almost 850 square feet of living space comprising two bedrooms, two bathrooms, and a private enclosed balcony, a tranquil escape during the warm summer months. The interior is finished to a superior specification, with sandblasted concrete ceilings, exposed brickwork, wooden flooring, and floor-to-ceiling windows in traditional proportions. While built to modern standards, the design reflects the industrial heritage of the site and surrounding area. At the heart of the apartment is an impressive and thoughtfully arranged open-plan living space, framed by an exposed concrete ceiling, industrial-style ducting and a full-width brick feature wall, the room has a confident, modernist character, softened by warm timber flooring and carefully curated finishes. A generous seating area sits at the centre of the room, comfortably accommodating for both lounging and entertaining, while a defined dining area is positioned beside large sliding doors, drawing in natural light and creating a seamless connection to the outside. The kitchen is set slightly back from the main reception area, allowing it to remain sociable without dominating the space. Finished with navy blue cabinetry with stone worktops housing integrated appliances designed to complement the room rather than interrupt it. The private, enclosed balcony extends the living space further, a sheltered, usable area that works equally well for morning coffee or evening drinks, effectively functioning as an additional room for much of the year. Offered to market with no onward chain, sold with vacant possession and with 2-years newbuild warranty remaining, this is an excellent opportunity for the discerning buyer seeking a luxurious apartment in one of London Fields most sought-after developments. The Fisheries Occupies a prominent corner position at Mentmore Terrace and Lamb Lane just moments from London Fields park and the lido, enjoying a premium location, situated just a stone’s throw away from London Fields Overground station, providing direct services to Liverpool Street in a little over 5-minutes. The surrounding area continues to attract young, lively and interesting people, drawn to its open spaces, central location, and cultural scene. Broadway Market and Wells Street Market are nearby with some of the most innovative places to eat and drink in the borough. results.summary: Set in this exciting new development, this modern two-bedroom apartment offers generous living in a well-connected corner of Walthamstow. With two bedrooms and a private outdoor terrace, it’s perfectly designed for comfort and ease. You’re just a short stroll from the charm of Walthamstow Village, with Lloyd Park, Chestnuts Fields and the William Morris Gallery all close by. The green expanse of Walthamstow Wetlands is just a short cycle away, while Walthamstow Town Hall stands moments from your door. A versatile home in a location that brings everything within easy reach.
