A wide entrance hall leads into a spacious open-plan kitchen, dining and reception area. Soft green cabinetry is paired with striking marble-style surfaces and fluted upper cupboards. Timber panelling beneath the staircase adds a stylish focal point, while full-height glazing opens onto a private balcony. There are two bedrooms with glazing at one end, along with built-in shelving. Completing this floor is a full bathroom, with a deep bathtub set beneath a striking tiled feature wall and a rainfall shower above, finished in a monochrome palette with crisp finishes, creating a cohesive feel. Step outside and you’ll find a vibrant neighbourhood rich in culture, green spaces and local favourites. Lloyd Park is just moments away, offering wide open lawns, a lively weekend market and the renowned William Morris Gallery, surrounded by gardens and mature trees. For a change of pace, make your way to Walthamstow Village, one of London’s most characterful urban enclaves. Here, winding streets and pretty cottages set the scene for a thriving mix of independent shops, cosy cafes and destination dining. Enjoy a laid-back meal at Eat 17 or settle in at The Nags Head, a local institution known for its warm atmosphere and classic pub fare. The recently opened Soho Theatre brings a new creative energy to the area, while the Wood Street Indoor Market is a treasure trove of vintage goods and collectibles. Walthamstow Wetlands, Chestnut Fields and the handsome Town Hall grounds all add to the area’s wide appeal. WHAT ELSE? Walthamstow Central Station is within easy reach, offering fast connections via the Victoria Line and Overground, making commutes into central London swift and seamless. For additional Overground links, Walthamstow Queens Road is also nearby, opening up convenient routes across the city. results.summary: A delightful period home of distinction and provenance with an intriguing history dating back to the 16th century*. What immediately strikes you upon entering this home, amongst the fine period detail, is the quality of the decorative condition and genteel colour tones. The current owners have furnished the property to a contemporary style, which works incredibly well, in fact, a breath a fresh air in a property of its age. Conversely, the interior space is timeless and due to both scale and volume, it would quite easily support a more traditional style of furnishing. You are greeted by an inviting entrance vestibule with charming double doors to an inner hallway. This, in turn, opens to a magnificent central hallway housing an imposing staircase with a noticeably tall ceiling, enriched with intricate plaster moulded cornicing and finished with a beautifully decorated mural ? akin to something you would expect to find in a museum or gallery. Other rooms on the ground floor include a library / study with bespoke joinery, a fireplace, and operational box sash windows with shutters, as well as an impressive dining room with open fireplace, solid walnut flooring, and a triple bay window overlooking Hampton Court Green. To the rear is a lovely family room with French windows, adjacent to this is a breakfast room leading to the kitchen with boot room beyond. results.summary: This luxurious four bedroom apartment offers exceptional lateral space and a tremendous amount of natural light throughout due to a clever layout. This home is the result of two properties being developed into one to make one fabulous home on the fifth floor of a well maintained portered building. Accessed via lift, the property opens into a hall with guest WC and leads into a large dining area where the main reception room and modern kitchen can be accessed. The south facing living room has multiple doors out onto a balcony that overlooks the green spaces of Hyde Park, while the fully fitted kitchen boasts high end integrated appliances, range cooker and kitchen island. The bright principal bedroom features two dressing rooms, smart en suite bathroom and private balcony. The second half of the apartment offers additional reception space plus three good sized bedrooms, shower room, bathroom and utility room. The property also benefits from a private double garage, two staff studios on the lower ground floor, storage room and an additional studio held on a separate lease. Albion Gate is located on Bayswater Road, opposite the delightful open spaces of Hyde Park. Transport links available from Paddington Station include the Heathrow Express, National Rail and Hammersmith & City, Circle, District and Bakerloo lines. The many bars, restaurants and theatres of the West End are all within close proximity. results.summary: A stunning west Putney detached family home on this much coveted road. Description A sublime, spacious and beautifully considered double fronted period detached house (4,065 sq ft) on the preferred west side of this much coveted west Putney road. The property has been extensively and sympathetically remodelled and extended in recent years, with great flare and attention to detail throughout. The flow of accommodation, over three floors, plus cellar, is ideal for family living with all that this entails. The finish is exceptional and consistently high throughout and this is a testament to the vision and expertise of the interior design team involved in the works to create a stunning and practical family home. The plot is a generous size and the front and rear gardens provide both a beautiful approach to the house and backdrop, allowing ample space for the needs of a growing family, whilst also giving structure and ease of maintenance. The front door leads into a spacious and welcoming hall and to the right, immediately on entry is the study. A large bay window gives a fine outlook over the front garden and beyond and this is an ideal space for home working. To the left is a good sized reception room, again with a bay window bringing in plenty of light and sky and bespoke cabinetry allowing for all things family entertainment. To the rear left of the house is the elegant formal drawing room, with a pretty fireplace being a focal point and large French doors leading onto a particularly private and secluded south and west facing patio. A recent side extension provides both a utility room and downstairs cloakroom, also leading through to the rear of the house and garden beyond. The hub of the property is the magnificent kitchen / breakfast / family room, with the hand made Treyone kitchen being its focal point with both Gaggenau and Miele appliances. The banquette dining area and split level design give a good degree of definition to the kitchen, dining and reception spaces, whilst also affording a particularly light and spacious feel and flow to this space. The vaulted ceiling is a very unusual feature and rounds it all off just beautifully. There is level access to the wonderful mature and beautifully designed and landscaped garden. The views out are superb, with the outlook being particularly private due to clever planting, landscaping and the considerable distance between the house and its nearest neighbours: Privacy is therefore assured and the eye is drawn down the garden path, towards the bespoke garden room, currently used as a family games room. Working back to the house itself, the sumptuous principal bedroom suite is at first floor level with its ample Smallbone wardrobes and recently updated en suite facilities, providing both a bath and separate shower; also double sinks. There are three further double bedrooms on this floor, one of which is currently beautifully fitted out as a second study and this shares a wonderful outlook with the other rear facing double bedroom, affording far reaching views over the garden and beyond. All three bedrooms are very well served by the recently updated family bathroom, again with both a bath and separate shower. The top floor is given over to two further good sized double bedrooms and these both share the use of a newly fitted family shower room. Furthermore, there is ample eaves storage, easily accessible from both bedrooms and the landing. Lastly there is a cellar with built in wine racks which also houses the brand new Keston boiler and water tank. The bespoke garden room to the rear of the plot is mains powered and there is also a tap behind it, which feeds the automatic irrigation system. A pretty courtyard style decked area also provides a wonderful spot for teenagers to congregate around an open fire pit. To the south side of the property, there is covered, secure access to the rear garden and this also provides a useful storage space for mowers and bicycles, etc. Having sold this house to our clients in 2004, we are delighted to welcome them back as sellers. Whilst the house they bought through us was beautiful indeed, the alterations, improvements and maintenance they have carried out since have raised this property into another league. It is now absolutely best in class. Location Set on a quiet, tree lined road in the heart of West Putney, Castello Avenue is one of the area’s most desirable residential addresses, known for its handsome family houses. The property enjoys excellent connectivity, with Putney mainline station offering fast services to London Waterloo, and East Putney Underground Station (District Line) close by. Putney High Street provides an excellent selection of shops, cafés and restaurants, while Putney Common, Wimbledon Common and the River Thames offer outstanding outdoor space. The area is also exceptionally well served by both high performing state and respected independent schools, making it ideal for family living. results.summary: Keating Estates are proud to present to market an exceptional one double bedroom apartment with a South-East facing private terrace and walk-in wardrobe, set within a sought-after luxury building. This lovely home is quietly positioned on the third floor with an abundance of natural light. Full Description - Keating Estates are proud to present to market an exceptional one double bedroom apartment with a South-East facing private terrace and walk-in wardrobe, set within a sought-after luxury building. Somerset Place is located in the heart of vibrant Brixton and this secure apartment is perfect for anyone who wants to have everything on their doorstep, yet be quietly positioned on the third floor with an abundance of natural light. Forming the heart of the home, the open-plan reception room boasts floor-to-ceiling glass dominating one of the walls, promoting a wonderfully bright yet private ambience which is further enhanced by the elevated position over the third floor. Benefitting from all the advantages of modern open-plan living there are fantastic proportions in which to relax, cook, dine and entertain whilst soaking in the views. The comfortable lounge area is the ideal place to unwind in an evening, accompanied by the twinkling lights of the city around you, whilst the contemporary kitchen is fully integrated and neatly arranged within sleek cabinetry, still allowing room for a dining table or breakfast island. Allowing the summer air to breeze through the room, sliding doors connect the living space seamlessly to the private terrace. South-East facing this low-maintenance balcony is perfect for al-fresco dining or simply drinking in the scenery, with views over Brixton Orchard, St Matthew’s Church and the surrounding neighbourhood. Tastefully presented, the bedroom is a generous and bright double with full-height glass windows on two aspects, a lovely setting for relaxing weekends enjoying a morning coffee or star gazing with a glass of your favourite tipple. The proportions allow space for a large bed, with plenty of room for further storage and a desk or dressing table if desired. Sliding doors lead off the bedroom into an impressive walk-in wardrobe. The bathroom is spacious and soothing, mirrored storage promotes a tidy finish and there is a bathtub as well as overhead shower, complete with a heated towel rail. Other selling points include underfloor heating throughout, built-in storage in the entrance and recessed downlighting. The building benefits from lift access, time still remaining on a 10-year building warranty, handy secure bike storage, lockers for parcels, a resident's garden and a large resident's roof terrace with impressive views across the area. Situated in the heart of Brixton's cultural hub - just around the corner from The Ritzy and Windrush Square. Purchasers will be able to sample the culinary delights of a different nation's cuisine every day in the nearby Brixton Village and POP Brixton or enjoy an evening out at the Upstairs private members club. The popular green open spaces of Brockwell Park, along with its popular 1930’s Lido, are also a short stroll. There are excellent transport links on offer with the first stop on the Victoria Line at Brixton station and the Northern Line is accessible within a fifteen-minute walk at Clapham North tube station. The amenities on Clapham High Street with the Overground station are on offer within walking distance, covering the wants and needs for the majority of potential purchasers. Early registration of interest is strongly advised. results.summary: A spacious two bed apartment located in the modern Gainsborough Studios development. Description Positioned on the fifth floor of the landmark Gainsborough Studios development, this well presented apartment offers thoughtfully arranged accommodation within one of Islington’s most distinctive and sought after residential buildings. The property comprises two well proportioned bedrooms, a contemporary bathroom, and a spacious open plan reception room with an integrated kitchen. The apartment also benefits from ample built in storage. Residents benefit from lift access, a secure entry system and the reassurance of a professionally managed development. Gainsborough Studios is widely recognised as one of North London’s most iconic residential conversions, combining striking architectural character with contemporary urban living. Offered to the market chain free. The building currently has a valid EWS1 A1 rating. Location Gainsborough Studios is a highly regarded modern development, occupying the site of, and incorporating elements from Alfred Hitchcock’s former film studios of the same name, lending the building a distinctive sense of character and heritage. The surrounding area is particularly appealing, with Hackney Basin (0.1 miles) and Shoreditch Park (0.1 miles) close by, alongside the renowned De Beauvoir Deli (0.5 miles) and an ever-growing selection of revitalised pubs, cafés and restaurants. The property is also conveniently positioned for Upper Street (0.8 miles), Angel (1 mile) and Shoreditch (1.1 miles), offering a wide range of shopping, dining and cultural amenities. Transport links are excellent, with Essex Road (0.53 miles), Haggerston and Hoxton (both 0.6 miles), Old Street (0.7 miles), Dalston Junction, Canonbury and Angel (all 0.8 miles), Moorgate (1.1 miles), London Liverpool Street Station (1.3 miles) and Highbury & Islington (1.1 miles) all within easy reach. These provide access to National Rail services, the London Overground (Windrush, Mildmay and Weaver Lines) and the London Underground, including the Northern, Circle, Hammersmith & City, Metropolitan and Elizabeth lines. results.summary: Nestled on the borders of Chelsea and Fulham, this newly renovated four-bedroom home spans nearly 3,500 sq ft and offers the perfect blend of period charm and contemporary design. A welcoming entrance opens into a stunning double reception room, anchored by a striking central feature fireplace by Chesneys, and bespoke joinery by Tom Howley. High ceilings, original detailing, crystal chandeliers and large sash windows flood the space with natural light from either end of the room, creating a perfect setting for both relaxed living and formal entertaining. The heart of the home lies on the lower ground floor, where an expansive lounge area flows seamlessly into a brand new bespoke eat-in kitchen and dining space, all by Tom Howley. Designed with entertaining in mind, the lounge area encompasses a bespoke television unit taking an entire wall, and the kitchen features a large island, Miele and Liebherr appliances, a stainless steel Bertazzoni double range and significant storage options. Full-width sliding glass doors open directly onto the beautifully landscaped, south-facing garden—a serene outdoor retreat ideal for al fresco dining and relaxing. The first floor is home to a spacious and light-filled office, perfect for working from home in peace and privacy. Again, Tom Howley have done an outstanding job with the joinery which is both practical and aesthetically pleasing, and the room overlooks the south-facing garden. The principal suite is also found on this floor which spans the entire length of the house and includes a large bedroom area, extensive built-in storage, and a stylish en-suite bathroom by CP Hart. Upstairs, the second floor features two generous double bedrooms and a well-appointed family bathroom, also by CP Hart. Each room is beautifully finished, with ample storage and plenty of natural light. The top floor reveals a further large double bedroom suite with a walk-in wardrobe and an expansive CP Hart bathroom, offering excellent privacy and flexibility for guests, older children, or perhaps another principal room. Between the second and third floors is an outdoor terrace, accessed via double doors. It features Millboard non-slip decking and is ideal for enjoying a relaxing morning coffee or serving as a private retreat for guests staying on the upper floors. Located just moments from Fulham Broadway, Parsons Green, and the boutique shops and cafés of New Kings Road, Moore Park Road is one of Fulham’s most desirable residential streets. Excellent transport links, outstanding local schools, and nearby green spaces such as Eel Brook Common make this a perfect home for families and professionals alike. Further to the fundamentals, the house benefits from air conditioning, a boot room and full utility room by Tom Howley, and ample additional storage. A convenient work from home space has also been created by Tom Howley with bespoke joinery and downlighting. This exceptional property is a rare opportunity to acquire a turnkey, architecturally balanced home with superb proportions and elegant design throughout. results.summary: **SOLD OFF MARKET** Set on a peaceful, tree-lined street, this beautifully presented end-of-terrace Victorian house on Lowden Road offers exceptional style, generous proportions, and a refined blend of period character and contemporary design. Thoughtfully updated throughout, the home feels bright, elegant, and exceptionally well cared for - one of the finest examples of its kind in the area. A useful entrance lobby opens into a welcoming hallway, leading through to a stunning double reception room framed by a large bay window, high ceilings, original cornicing, and a handsome feature fireplace. This is a wonderfully versatile living space, ideal for both entertaining and everyday family life. To the rear, a spacious dining room flows directly into the beautifully appointed kitchen, complete with modern cabinetry, quality appliances, and access to the garden. The ground floor also benefits from a practical utility area, offering excellent storage and everyday convenience. Upstairs, the property features three generous double bedrooms. The principal bedroom sits to the front with a lovely outlook and plenty of space for wardrobes. The bedroom to the rear benefits from its own en-suite shower room, providing privacy and flexibility for guests or family members. A further well-proportioned double bedroom sits beside the spectacular main bathroom — a luxurious space finished with a freestanding bath, separate walk-in shower, and elegant contemporary fixtures. As an end-of-terrace home, the property enjoys additional natural light, enhanced privacy, and an especially airy feel throughout. The rear garden is peaceful and low-maintenance - perfect for al fresco dining and warm summer evenings. Lowden Road is a highly desirable residential street, ideally placed for the independent cafés, restaurants, and shops of Herne Hill and Tulse Hill. The home is perfectly positioned between two outstanding green spaces: Brockwell Park with its iconic Lido, and Ruskin Park, just a few minutes’ walk away and beloved for its open lawns, wildlife garden, and panoramic views of the City. A truly exceptional home - full of character, beautifully finished, and ready to move straight into. results.summary: ***Guide Price £700,000-£750,000*** Marriott Vernon present to the market this wonderful four bedroom detached bungalow with delightful west facing garden and off street parking for several cars, pleasantly situated in a sought after Sanderstead location just a short walk from Sanderstead Village with it's local amenities. The property has been beautifully maintained and appointed by the current owner, offering bright and spacious accommodation with modern interiors and quality finish throughout. Flowing living space creates the perfect blend of comfort and convenience, with a large reception hallway, stunning reception/living room, a well equipped kitchen and two bath/shower rooms (one en-suite). Features include gas central heating and double glazing. Accommodation comprises entrance lobby, leading into an inviting reception hallway with skylight window, opening through to a reception/living room with wood burner and bi-folding doors onto the attractive garden – perfect for al fresco entertaining and family life. The separate kitchen comprises a range of white high gloss wall and base units with oak work surfaces, incorporating inset sink unit, Bosch double oven and hob, integrated ‘Bosch’ fridge freezer and dishwasher, and further space for appliances. There are four well proportioned bedrooms – one en-suite, and a further bedroom with garden access - plus a family bathroom. The property is enviably located in the Sanderstead area, within easy access of good local bus routes providing an easy connection into Croydon and Purley town centres. Sanderstead itself offers a variety of shops, restaurants and local amenities, and the area is well served by excellent local schools including Atwood Primary, Gresham Primary, Hamsey Green Infants and Juniors, Riddlesdown Collegiate and Warlingham School, all within easy reach. Purley and Croydon town centres are also just a short bus or car ride away. results.summary: Step into a home that’s been filled with happiness and is now ready for you to write its next chapter. This beautifully bright two-bedroom, two-bathroom apartment isn’t just a place to live, it’s a lifestyle of comfort, convenience and connection. Designed for modern living, the layout is as practical as it is inviting. Both bedrooms offer generous proportions, while the principal suite features its own ensuite for that extra touch of privacy. At the heart of the home, the light-filled living space flows seamlessly onto your own private balcony, a perfect spot for morning coffees or unwinding as the day winds down. Life here is effortlessly easy. With secure underground allocated parking, you’ll never have to think twice about coming and going. The dedicated concierge adds a layer of everyday luxury, from taking in deliveries to offering a warm, familiar face, making daily life feel smoother and more secure. For young families, the location is a dream. The renowned Banana Moon nursery is right on your doorstep, offering peace of mind and a gentle start to the day for little ones. The neighbourhood itself has a wonderfully calm, friendly atmosphere, the kind of place where you quickly feel at home. When it’s time to explore further afield, you couldn’t be better placed. Waddon station and Wandle Park tram stop are just moments away, putting Central London within easy reach. Whether it’s direct trains to Victoria and London Bridge or Thameslink services to Blackfriars, Farringdon and King’s Cross St Pancras, the city is yours to enjoy, whether for work or evening adventures. When you crave a slower pace, Wandle Park is a short stroll away. This lovely green space is your local escape, ideal for weekend wanders, morning runs, or simply enjoying a breath of fresh air surrounded by nature. This isn’t just a flat, it’s a place where lifestyle, location and community come together beautifully. results.summary: This attractive four-bedroom townhouse is situated on a popular residential street in a gated mews just off Northcote Road. The accommodation measures approximately 1,313 sq ft and arranged over three floors offering well-proportioned principal rooms throughout, the property further benefits from a lovely garden and balcony. The spacious and bright open-plan kitchen and reception room offers ample space for both a dining table and comfortable seating with wooden floors that run the length of the room. The kitchen area is arranged to the rear with a range of wall and base units, integrated appliances and a pretty window behind the sink that overlooks the garden. French doors to the rear open out to the landscaped garden laid with patio tiles and decking. The garden has a great sense of privacy with the raised flower beds, mature shrubs and trees as well as built-in benches creating the ideal space for alfresco dining and entertainment. A downstairs WC completes the accommodation on this level. Two double bedrooms and a family bathroom are arranged on the first floor. The larger of the two bedrooms boasts built-in wardrobes and a pretty balcony with far reaching rooftop views. An additional double bedroom and the principal suite can be found on the second floor. The principal suite benefits from built-in wardrobes and an en suite bathroom with both a walk-in shower and a bath. This fantastic flat is situated just off Cairns Road in a gated mews called Turner Place, just minutes away from the amenities of Northcote Road. Transport can be found at Clapham Junction Overland, also within easy walking distance, and the wide-open spaces of both Wandsworth Common and Clapham Common are both just a short walk away. It is also well located for a number of popular state and independent schools, subject to catchment and places each year. results.summary: A beautifully presented two-bedroom, two-bathroom apartment set within a sought-after development in the heart of Bow, offering modern living with generous proportions and an abundance of natural light throughout. This spacious home features a well-appointed open-plan living and dining area, seamlessly connected to a private balcony overlooking the tranquil communal gardens—Being on the second floor, the balcony gets afternoon sun -- perfect for relaxing or entertaining. The contemporary kitchen is fully fitted with integrated appliances and ample worktop space, ideal for both everyday living and hosting. Both bedrooms are generously sized doubles, with the principal bedroom benefiting from a stylish en-suite bathroom. A second modern family bathroom serves the rest of the property, finished to a high standard. The apartment further benefits from excellent storage solutions throughout and excellent built-in storage including a dedicated utility/storage cupboard ensuring a clutter-free living environment. Residents enjoy access to well-maintained communal gardens, adding a peaceful green retreat within the development. results.summary: Guide Price £1,050,000 - £1,150,000 A stunning detached Victorian residence, built in 1897, meticulously restored and upgraded to an exceptionally high standard. This beautiful home combines timeless character with contemporary quality and is offered chain-free. Situated on a quiet residential road, the property offers a peaceful and secure environment, making it particularly well suited to families or those seeking tranquillity away from busy main roads. Constructed in traditional yellow London stock brick, the property has been sympathetically refurbished since 2018, including specialist brick cleaning and repointing, giving it superb kerb appeal. The ground floor features a bright open-plan living space that flows seamlessly into a bespoke kitchen, completed in 2023, with quartz worktops, a water softener, a boiling water tap, and an InSinkErator system. Floor-to-ceiling windows flood the space with natural light, while underfloor heating in the kitchen enhances comfort. Hardwood flooring runs throughout the property, with parquet flooring in the upper bedrooms. The ground floor also includes a generous double bedroom with an ensuite and a separate W/C for added convenience. results.summary: A superb two bedroom garden flat offering almost 1,000 sq ft of immaculate accommodation together with a 31 ft private garden. With its own front door, the property has been beautifully refurbished by the current owners a comprises a stunning, light filled open-plan reception room/kitchen with light wood floors, a sleek, contemporary kitchen with plenty of storage, quartz work surfaces, metro tiled splashbacks, integrated appliances and a large central island with breakfast bar. There is ample room to sit, dine and entertain and glazed French doors lead directly to the garden. There are two generous, double bedrooms, one at the front and one at the back overlooking the garden. Both are a good size and the bedroom to the rear has a walk-in dressing room and double doors leading to the garden. There is also a very smart family bathroom. Access to a useful cellar and utility room completes the accommodation. Of particular note is the wonderful 31 ft private garden with rear access, ideal for al-fresco entertaining in the summer months. St. Ann's Crescent is a pretty tree lined street close to the open spaces of Wandsworth Common. It is well placed for the local amenities and more extensive shopping is available at the Southside Centre. Transport links are excellent with Wandsworth Town, Clapham Junction and Earlsfield stations nearby, providing services to Victoria and Waterloo. Furthermore, the area as a whole is renowned for its excellent choice of private and state schools, subject to catchment and entrance each year. results.summary: A brilliant three bed split level Victorian conversion located a short stroll from both Sydenham Overground (to London Bridge) and Penge East rail (to London Victoria). With accommodation of almost 1,000 sq ft arranged over three floors, the scale and proportions of this property are impressive and rivals the space of some houses in the area. The owners have injected personality and character by using tones that invite and envelop, whilst the large windows bask the entire space in natural light. On entry you're immediately greeted by a superb sense of space; comprising a wonderful reception of 17 x 14'7 ft beautifully lit during the day by the generous bay window, a brand new kitchen breakfast room providing a lovely space to gather for meals, with plenty of storage and work surfaces, two double bedrooms, which are both large enough to accommodate king sized beds and additional furniture providing flexibility for various furniture layouts whilst also creating cosy yet uncluttered spaces. There is also a third room, currently used as a work space/study and a modern good-sized bathroom with a ceramic tub and overhead shower. The apartment's location in Sydenham is prime, providing easy access to independent restaurants, coffee shops and excellent transport links. There are several parks close by, including Mayow, Wells and Crystal Palace Park which has a weekly Sunday market; all the things that this charming part of South East London is known and loved for. results.summary: A well-presented three-storey terraced home, ideal for growing families and investors, with further potential to extend up to 6 metres (STPP). An attractive opportunity offering both immediate comfort and future growth potential. results.summary: A charming three bedroom semi detached home, thoughtfully renovated to combine modern style with a real sense of character. Description - This charming three bedroom semi detached home located on Hazel Avenue, has been thoughtfully renovated to combine modern style with a real sense of character. The interiors includes tasteful finishes alongside original features that give the property warmth and personality. To the rear, a particularly generous garden provides a wonderful extension of the living space. Accommodation - The accommodation is well arranged and flows naturally from a welcoming entrance hall. To the front, a well proportioned reception room enjoys good natural light, creating a comfortable and inviting space for everyday living. To the rear, the kitchen is thoughtfully laid out with a practical layout and direct access to the garden, making it particularly well suited to modern family life. Upstairs, there are three bedrooms, including two generous doubles and a third room ideal as a child’s bedroom, study or dressing room. These are served by a family bathroom. Externally, the property is further enhanced by a substantial rear garden, which incorporates a covered veranda, summer house and a separate workshop, offering excellent versatility for those working from home or seeking additional entertaining space. Outside, the property benefits from a particularly generous rear garden, laid to lawn with a paved terrace providing an ideal setting for outdoor dining and entertaining. The space is both private and versatile. To the front, there is off street parking, along with useful side access leading through to the rear garden. The property also offers excellent scope for further enlargement, with clear potential to extend to the side, rear and into the loft, subject to the usual planning permissions, allowing an incoming purchaser to tailor the house to their own requirements. Location - West Drayton is well regarded for its excellent connectivity and growing appeal among commuters. West Drayton Station provides access to the Elizabeth Line, offering fast and direct services into Central London, the West End and Canary Wharf, as well as convenient links to Heathrow Airport. The nearby M4 and M25 further enhance road connections across London and the wider motorway network. The area benefits from a good range of local amenities, including shops, supermarkets and independent cafés, with more extensive retail and leisure facilities available in nearby Uxbridge. There are a selection of well regarded schools and access to open green spaces. It offers well-proportioned accommodation, comprising on the ground floor a spacious entrance hall, cloakroom, living room, and a large kitchen/diner with French doors opening onto the rear garden. To the first floor are three bedrooms and a family bathroom, while the top floor provides a fourth bedroom/studio with an open-plan kitchen area and a separate shower room. Externally, the property benefits from a 30ft rear garden, designed for low maintenance with astroturf, rockery features, and an outside boiler cupboard. Lavengo Road is conveniently located within easy reach of West Dulwich and Dulwich Village, both renowned for their parks, outstanding schools, shops, restaurants, picture gallery, and golf course. The area also offers excellent transport links into central London, with nearby stations including West Dulwich (Victoria) and Tulse Hill (London Bridge and Blackfriars). Offered to the market with no onward chain. results.summary: A spectacular home with incredible views of Wandsworth Common and London Skyline in a highly sought after area. Description A spectacular four/five-bedroom home, refurbished and extended to an exceptional standard, combining elegant design with advanced smart home technology. Boasting incredible views of Wandsworth Common, this residence blends style and functionality. The reception room features parquet floors, a double-aspect gas fireplace, and a large bay window overlooking the Common. Adjacent is the spacious kitchen and dining area, filled with natural light from a glass-paneled ceiling and crittall glass back wall. The kitchen offers marble-topped units, a breakfast bar, and space for a large dining table. Crittall doors open onto a paved garden with direct street access, ideal for bikes. A downstairs cloakroom completes the ground floor. The lower ground floor showcases Art Deco-inspired cabinetry and inlaid woodwork, with dramatic lighting along a corridor leading to a family room with a bay window and adjoining store. This floor also includes a secondary kitchen, bathroom, and study. At the rear is a library-media room with surround sound (which could also be a fifth bedroom), a climate-controlled wine cellar, and elegant cabinetry. Another crittall door leads outside. The principal bedroom suite on the first floor offers views of Wandsworth Common, ornate cornic­ing, wooden floors, a dressing room with built-in wardrobes, and a marble en suite bathroom with bath, shower, and twin sinks. The second floor has two bedrooms, a family bathroom, and a store room with washer and dryer. The fourth bedroom is on the top floor, accessed via a staircase with an exposed brick feature wall. It includes an en suite, built-in wardrobes, and a full glass wall with stunning London skyline views. Location Bolingbroke Grove runs along the east side of Wandsworth Common and benefits from all the Common’s good recreational facilities. There are wonderful local shops, bars and restaurants to be found on both Northcote Road (approximately 0.2 miles away) and Bellevue Road (approx. 0.5 miles away). Transport connections are good with Wandsworth Common mainline station (approx. 0.6 miles away), and Clapham Junction (approx. 0.8 miles away) linking to Victoria and Waterloo. The area is renowned for its excellent selection of schools both in the state and private sector. results.summary: The Olive House is based on the concept of building a unique home with a 100-year-old olive tree at its heart, planted in a central courtyard. The tree was transported from Italy and planted in the courtyard as this awe-inspiring house began to take shape around it.. The owners purchased the house, demolished then rebuilt it creating a unique, uplifting space designed by the award-winning, Threefold Architects. Renovation commenced in early 2017, and it took approximately three years to design and build. Set behind electric gates, this imposing double fronted, limestone-rendered home has its own presence on Aylestone Avenue. Upon entering this grand, modern home, you are immediately struck by the sense of light and volume. An inviting entrance hall with a curved glass staircase wraps around the house, showcasing the main centrepiece, an olive tree shipped from Italy and planted in an open courtyard. To the front of the house is a large, elegant reception room with a Regency design fireplace and panelled walls. A sizeable study complete with bespoke fitted units and shelving also sits to one side of the house and offers the perfect space for those working from home. The rear of the house unfolds into a light filled kitchen, dining and reception room with floor to ceiling glass overlooking a mature 91 ft private garden. Planning permission is approved for the addition of a 1000 sq. ft luxury pool house and gym. The bespoke, hand-built design kitchen by 202 Design features a Lacanche oven, a Fisher & Paykel integrated fridge and a Miele dishwasher. This leads to a well equipped utility room with hand built cabinets which follow seamlessly from or to the kitchen design, providing a vast amount of storage. The utility room also has a cut-away design within the cabinetry, creating a tidy, compact space for any pet. A second fridge, freezer, sink, and worktops offer additional food preparation space, which is convenient when entertaining. A boot room can also be accessed from the external side door which means muddy pets and kids can be ushered straight into the shower and cleaned before accessing the rest of the house. The much loved cinema room forms part of the main living space and has proved a popular spot amongst friends and family to unwind. The cinema features a 3m screen, a high-definition projection and surround sound built into the room – it’s the perfect room to watch sport or the latest blockbuster. There is also a luxurious guest cloakroom on the ground floor. The house has CAT 6 wiring and has wifi routers embedded in virtually every room. It is heavily automated and uses the Control 4 system to operate lighting, AV, security cameras and the gate entry system. The lighting, AV and security can all be operated remotely. Please note, we have not yet received confirmation from the client regarding certain information for this property. You should ensure you make your own enquiries regarding material information about this property. The house is situated in the heart of the prestigious Brondesbury Park, an area that consists of grand detached houses with large gardens. Aylestone Avenue is a wide, tree lined street and is known to be one of the most popular roads in NW6 for prime houses. Public green spaces including Tiverton Green and Queen's Park are close by and the house is situated around the corner from South Hampstead Tennis Club and the luxurious pool with a lovely, family friendly cafe at The Maqam Centre. results.summary: This spectacular two bedroom apartment with un-restricted river views in the award winning riverside development, The Tower, is available now chain free. This immaculate 14th floor apartment sits in a prime position of the building offering stunning river and Battersea Power Station views. The open plan living/ dining/ kitchen area has floor to ceiling windows allowing for an abundance of natural light. The state of the art kitchen is fully fitted with Miele appliances, a coffee machine and wine fridge. Off the living area is a winter garden and the property has 2 large double bedrooms and 2 bathrooms. results.summary: Positioned on the slopes of Coombe Hill, we are delighted to bring to the market six homes of a distinctive contemporary style sitting proudly within an elevated position that enjoys a wonderful southerly aspect. Due for completion between Spring and early Summer 2026, these houses are creatively designed and enhanced with the latest technology and fittings available today. These six homes are creatively designed and enhanced with the latest technology and fittings THE DEVELOPMENT With accommodation arranged over the ground, first and second floors, the design of the six houses is replicated within each property. On approach through the front door, one enters a spacious entrance hall with a cloaks cupboard and guest cloakroom with a welcoming 17ft living room with views to the front garden and driveway through a large picture window. The hall continues to the heart of the house being the stunning 30-foot open-plan space that seamlessly connects the kitchen, dining area, and family room, all bathed in natural light from the southerly aspect rear garden and terrace. This central hub, designed for both entertaining and everyday living, will feature bespoke contemporary or traditional kitchens by Q Joinery, complete with soft-close units, natural stone worktops, an induction hob, integrated fridge and freezer, and a breakfast bar. The living room will benefit from an over sized full height door that could be changed to double doors with early reservations. With 2.7m ceiling heights and completed with an oak engineered floor, this areas makes a delightful comfortable room. Engineered oak flooring runs throughout, complementing the ceiling heights and spacious dining area ideal for large gatherings. The family room opens to the garden through full-width bi-fold doors, offering a stylish and practical indoor-outdoor lifestyle. This area will be flooded with natural day light as it enjoys the southerly aspect. The easy rising staircase leads to the first floor with a 20ft x 16ft master bedroom suite which includes a dressing room and en-suite bathroom. A further bedroom and study together with a family bathroom complete this floor before entering the second-floor landing. This level offers two further bedrooms, a plant room and second family bathroom in addtion to the cinema/playroom which will welcome the whole family to put their feet up, relax and enjoy. DESIGN YOUR OWN HOME For early reservations, Lifestyle Projects are offering prospective buyers to design their own interiors including tiling, wall colourings, kitchen and bathrooms cabinetry and will welcome an informal conversation to make your home a dream home with the aid of Hugh Leslie renowned interior designer. the choice of interiors can also include a choice of colour to the chosen carpets by the developer or chose from one of two already selected. ENERGY ASSESSMENT THE HIGHEST PREDICTED ENERGY RATING The Predicted Energy Rating* of A is drawn from one of the six properties currently under construction. Once the properties are completed, this rating will be updated and an official Energy Performance Certificate will be created for each property. This will include more detailed information about the energy performance of each completed property. LOCATION Coombe Lane West is conveniently located close to Kingston and Wimbledon town centres with their excellent shopping facilities and the famous Wimbledon Village with its tempting boutiques, artisan shops, a selection of restaurants and coffee shops. Kingston-upon-Thames provides a wonderful blend of historical charm, modern amenities, and a long riverside of attractions. It’s known for its extensive shopping, including the Bentall Centre and John Lewis, as well as the historic market with its welcoming mix of fresh produce, artisan goods and crafts. Set on the banks of the River Thames, this relaxing riverside town has a superb variety of restaurants, pubs and coffee shops. Local information sources say it also boasts the Rose Theatre, a vibrant arts and culture scene, and is a short distance from Henry VIII favourite Palace at Hampton Court. The immediate area offers a wide range of recreational facilities including three notable golf courses, tennis and squash clubs. The 2,360 acres of Richmond Park, an area of outstanding beauty is easily accessed from Kingston Gate and Ladderstile Gate, providing a picturesque setting in which to picnic, go horse riding, jogging or just take a leisurely walk. In addtion to the Rose Theatre, Wimbledon and Richmond theatres are also popular alternatives to the West End. There are also highly acclaimed private, state and international schools for all ages within the immediate vicinity and this prestigious development is also within walking distance. For Holy Cross Prep School for Girls, Rokeby School for Boys and Marymount International School for Girls along George Road. These can be approached on foot via a footpath off Warren Cutting which is approached towards the end of Golf Club Drive which leads into Edgecoombe Close and onto Warren and George Road. The pick up bus point for LEH and Hampton Boys is a stones throw from these houses along Coombe Lane West. The A3 trunk road offering fast access to central London and both Gatwick and Heathrow airports via the M25 motorway. The nearest train stations at Norbiton, New Malden and Raynes Park are within walking distance and provide frequent services to London Waterloo (25 minutes approx..) with its underground links throughout the city. The hall continues to the heart of the house being the stunning 30-foot open-plan space that seamlessly connects the kitchen, dining area, and family room, all bathed in natural light from the southerly aspect rear garden and terrace. This central hub, designed for both entertaining and everyday living, will feature bespoke contemporary or traditional kitchens by Q Joinery, complete with soft-close units, natural stone worktops, an induction hob, integrated fridge and freezer, and a breakfast bar. The living room will benefit from an over sized full height door that could be changed to double doors with early reservations. With 2.7m ceiling heights and completed with an oak engineered floor, this areas makes a delightful comfortable room. Engineered oak flooring runs throughout, complementing the ceiling heights and spacious dining area ideal for large gatherings. The family room opens to the garden through full-width bi-fold doors, offering a stylish and practical indoor-outdoor lifestyle. This area will be flooded with natural day light as it enjoys the southerly aspect. The easy rising staircase leads to the first floor with a 20ft x 16ft master bedroom suite which includes a dressing room and en-suite bathroom. A further bedroom and study together with a family bathroom complete this floor before entering the second-floor landing. This level offers two further bedrooms, a plant room and second family bathroom in addtion to the cinema/playroom which will welcome the whole family to put their feet up, relax and enjoy. DESIGN YOUR OWN HOME For early reservations, Lifestyle Projects are offering prospective buyers to design their own interiors including tiling, wall colourings, kitchen and bathrooms cabinetry and will welcome an informal conversation to make your home a dream home with the aid of Hugh Leslie renowned interior designer. the choice of interiors can also include a choice of colour to the chosen carpets by the developer or chose from one of two already selected. Once the properties are completed, this rating will be updated and an official Energy Performance Certificate will be created for each property. This will include more detailed information about the energy performance of each completed property. LOCATION Coombe Lane West is conveniently located close to Kingston and Wimbledon town centres with their excellent shopping facilities and the famous Wimbledon Village with its tempting boutiques, artisan shops, a selection of restaurants and coffee shops. Kingston-upon-Thames provides a wonderful blend of historical charm, modern amenities, and a long riverside of attractions. It’s known for its extensive shopping, including the Bentall Centre and John Lewis, as well as the historic market with its welcoming mix of fresh produce, artisan goods and crafts. Set on the banks of the River Thames, this relaxing riverside town has a superb variety of restaurants, pubs and coffee shops. Local information sources say it also boasts the Rose Theatre, a vibrant arts and culture scene, and is a short distance from Henry VIII favourite Palace at Hampton Court. The immediate area offers a wide range of recreational facilities including three notable golf courses, tennis and squash clubs. The 2,360 acres of Richmond Park, an area of outstanding beauty is easily accessed from Kingston Gate and Ladderstile Gate, providing a picturesque setting in which to picnic, go horse riding, jogging or just take a leisurely walk. In addtion to the Rose Theatre, Wimbledon and Richmond theatres are also popular alternatives to the West End. There are also highly acclaimed private, state and international schools for all ages within the immediate vicinity and this prestigious development is also within walking distance. For Holy Cross Prep School for Girls, Rokeby School for Boys and Marymount International School for Girls along George Road. These can be approached on foot via a footpath off Warren Cutting which is approached towards the end of Golf Club Drive which leads into Edgecoombe Close and onto Warren and George Road. The pick up bus point for LEH and Hampton Boys is a stones throw from these houses along Coombe Lane West. The A3 trunk road offering fast access to central London and both Gatwick and Heathrow airports via the M25 motorway. The nearest train stations at Norbiton, New Malden and Raynes Park are within walking distance and provide frequent services to London Waterloo (25 minutes approx..) with its underground links throughout the city. results.summary: Kate Brookfield presents this beautifully maintained 1920s semi-detached house on Anson Road, NW2. Commanding a prestigious corner plot position, this home is rich in original period detail and offers magnificent space and natural light. It boasts a wealth of highlights, including the original handmade kitchen, period tiles, parquet flooring, wall panelling, and a superb walled garden. The striking front door leads into a double porch, with space on either side for shoes and coats. Above the door, the original fanlight and side windows allow light to pour into the hallway. From the porch, double doors open into the main hall, where you are immediately met with stunning flooring, wall panelling, and a grand fireplace. This wide central space provides access to all areas of the house. To the front sits the first of six ground floor rooms, currently used as a dining space and capable of accommodating up to twenty guests. The room showcases another original fireplace and a bay fitted with original Crittall slim-framed windows — a feature that continues throughout the home. To the rear of the ground floor is the formal living space, finished in rich, warm décor, with a working fireplace and a wall of original windows alongside double doors leading onto the garden. On the far side of the ground floor sits the original kitchen, now used as a breakfast room adjoining the main kitchen. It is a delight to see the 1920s handmade cabinets and glass fronted units, carefully maintained and still serving an important role in the space. The chimney breast — where an oven may once have stood — is surrounded by Dutch tiles, a nod to the Arts and Crafts era. The main kitchen has been modernised by the current owners and opens onto a sunny conservatory with further doors to the garden and side access to the house. This space leads to an office that connects back to the main entrance hall. A guest WC completes the ground floor. A striking wide staircase leads to the first floor, passing a large window that allows natural light to flow freely into the house. Five bedrooms complete this level, along with a modernised family bathroom, a separate WC, and an en-suite shower room. Two bedrooms feature attractive fireplaces with glazed and original cabinetry. There is also a large loft space, offering potential to extend the home (STPP). The garden is filled with mature trees, and the high brick walls provide excellent privacy. A patio directly off the rear of the house offers the perfect spot for morning tea or evening dining in warmer months, while the large lawn provides space for children to play. The house benefits from a driveway offering parking for two cars, as well as a fully usable garage. This is an incredibly special house, seeking a new owner to love and cherish it for many years to come. Anson Road is positioned among the highly sought after streets of Willesden Green and is close to the beautiful Gladstone Park. The area is favoured for its proximity to the amenities of Willesden Green, West Hampstead, Queen’s Park, and Cricklewood, and is conveniently located for quick access to Brent Cross, the A406, and the M1. results.summary: Located on the highly desirable Monkham’s Estate, this impressive three-bedroom detached chalet bungalow on Knighton Close has been significantly upgraded and substantially extended by its current owner, creating a spacious and versatile home arranged over two floors. The property offers a thoughtful blend of modern family living and flexible accommodation, making it ideal for a range of buyers including families and those seeking generous ground floor space in a prestigious residential setting. The property opens into a welcoming entrance hall which leads through to a bright and comfortable living room positioned at the front of the home. From the hallway, there is access to a family bathroom, a bedroom currently used as an office/study and leads through to a large ground floor bedroom with its own en-suite, as well as a dressing area. The heart of the home is the impressive air conditioned lounge, open-plan kitchen featuring a central island and ample space for dining and entertaining, with bi-fold doors opening onto the rear garden with an extensive patio. A separate utility room provides additional practicality and internal access to the garage. There is also an extensive storage area and cloakroom in the main hall. Upstairs, the first floor offers a further spacious bedroom and an additional bathroom with shower, creating a private upper-level retreat that could suit guests or older children. A Juliet Balcony overlooks the garden. The property has ample storage and is in excellent condition throughout. Knighton Close forms part of the prestigious Monkham’s Estate, one of Woodford Green’s most sought-after residential areas, known for its quiet tree-lined roads and attractive detached homes. The property is conveniently positioned for Woodford Underground Station (Central Line), offering direct access into the City and West End, while the vibrant Woodford Green High Road provides a wide range of shops, cafés, restaurants, and everyday amenities. The area is also popular with families due to its proximity to highly regarded schools and beautiful green spaces, including Epping Forest and nearby parks, making it an ideal location for those seeking a balance of suburban tranquility and excellent connectivity. results.summary: We are delighted to present this charming three-bedroom family home, perfectly situated in the highly sought-after area of Pinner. Offering generous living space, a substantial rear garden, and the reassurance of recently updated electrical and heating systems, this inviting property presents an exceptional opportunity for families seeking a comfortable, well-located home. Whether you envisage a cosy family lounge for everyday living or a separate dining room for hosting friends and special occasions, the layout offers flexibility to suit modern family life. The natural flow between rooms enhances the sense of space and practicality. The kitchen is functional and well-arranged, offering ample preparation and storage space. It provides an excellent foundation to personalise and enhance over time. For those seeking open-plan living, there is clear potential (subject to the necessary consents) to reconfigure and create a contemporary kitchen-dining-family space tailored to today’s lifestyle. Significantly larger than many comparable homes in the area, it offers an expansive outdoor space rarely found locally. Ideal for families, entertaining, gardening enthusiasts, or even future extension potential (subject to planning), the garden provides a wonderful sense of privacy and room to grow. Whether enjoying summer dining, watching children play, or simply relaxing outdoors, this space is a genuine asset to the home. Further benefits include recently updated electrical and heating systems, providing added peace of mind and energy efficiency for the next owners. Pinner remains one of North West London’s most desirable locations, known for its vibrant community feel, excellent schools, independent shops, cafés, and restaurants. results.summary: The Property Beautifully Extended 4 Bedroom Terrace Home close to the Elizabeth line – Immaculate Throughout Situated on the sought after Framfield Road, in the heart of W7, this beautifully presented home is minutes away from Hanwell station with the Elizabeth line going to Central London (Paddington in 18 minutes, Liverpool street in 27 minutes). This thoughtfully extended four double bedroom terraced home offers generous living space arranged seamlessly over three floors. Perfect for families and those seeking a stylish, ready to move into property. Ground Floor The ground floor features a superb through lounge leading to a spacious dining room, creating an open and versatile living space ideal for entertaining or everyday family life. Large windows with shutters, an original focal fireplace and and tasteful décor enhance the light and airy feel. To the rear sits a well appointed kitchen with underfloor heating. It is part of the full-width rear and side extension, offering excellent workspace including a central island with integrated wine cooler and direct access to the garden via bi fold doors. First Floor The first floor hosts two well-proportioned double bedrooms, each offering comfortable, quiet retreats with built in storage and ample space for furniture. The family bathroom is finished with a traditional style suite comprising, a roll top bath, separate shower, wash basin and WC, providing a modern touch whilst retaining the period charm. Second Floor The property benefits from a superb loft conversion, creating two additional double bedrooms. The main loft bedroom includes a stylish ensuite shower room, making it ideal as a principal suite, guest space, or home office. Large eaves offer precious storage capacity. Garden To the rear is a lovely, neatly maintained garden, perfect for outdoor dining, relaxing, or play. The garden offers a mix of patio and lawn, with the added benefit of privacy and low maintenance. Location Ideally positioned on a quiet residential road in W7, the property is just a short walk from Hanwell Station for fast Elizabeth Line services into Central London and Heathrow. Excellent local amenities, popular cafés, independent shops, and supermarkets are all close by, along with a choice of well regarded schools. The green open spaces of Bunny park and Hanwell zoo are also within easy reach, perfect for walking, cycling, and family recreation. results.summary: This marvellous three-bedroom apartment forms part of The Grange, a late Georgian building in the Church Road conservation area, around 20 minutes' walk from the Crystal Palace Triangle. Its well-proportioned plan encompasses a grand double reception room, a principal bedroom lined with a series of French doors, and beautiful details including five marble fireplaces. Outdoors, there is off-road parking with EV charging, a shared garage, and a vibrant shared garden, with a pond and spots to sit and read. Setting the Scene Built in the early 19th century, The Grange is thought to be one of the oldest surviving mansions in the area. Its symmetrical three-storey design with lower wings is characteristic of the late Georgian style, although, unusually, its main entrance (today the entrance to the apartment) was positioned on the side of the hill to maximise the building’s views to the west. In 1853, the house was occupied by the Wiggs, a merchant trading family. It was later bought by Josiah Ritchie, managing director of the Royal Aquarium. His son, Major Ritchie, won three Olympic medals for tennis in the 1908 London games. It is thought that he would have trained in the grounds of The Grange, which previously extended further up the hill. The building was sensitively converted into apartments in 1919 and retains many of its original features, including grand fireplaces and curved window frames. The Grand Tour A smart, black-painted front door flanked by white stuccoed columns forms the private entrance to the apartment. Inside, a vast entrance hall with soaring ceilings traced by ornate cornicing gives the first indication of this home’s grand proportions. At one end lies a voluminous double reception room washed in 'Hopper' by Little Greene. A beautiful bay window set into curved frames fills the space with light, while tall windows to one side capture leafy garden views. Each sitting area has an original marble fireplace and reinstated ceiling roses. The large kitchen has dark-stained floorboards and floor-to-ceiling French doors that open to a Juliet balcony. Walls and cabinetry have been painted in 'Obsidian Green' by Little Greene, and there is a forest-green Rangemaster oven. An original staircase with a curved handrail and delicate balusters ascends to a mezzanine, which would have once led to the upper floors of the house. The space is currently used as a peaceful library. The expansive principal bedroom is lined with a series of French doors on one side. Fitted storage provides ample room for clothes. Walls here are washed in 'Grosvenor Square' from Mylands, and there is a cast-iron fireplace on one side. A second double bedroom has a tall casement window with views toward the garden. There is also a bathroom, a shower room, and a neat WC from the study/third bedroom, which is tucked behind blue-painted double doors underneath the staircase. The Great Outdoors A peaceful garden is shared with one other apartment. It has a delightful atmosphere, with a large pond, established plants including roses and lavender, and a playhouse. An off-street parking space has an EV charging point. There is also use of a shared garage. Out and

results.summary: An exceptionally well-presented first floor, two bedroom flat for sale in the popular area of Clapton. With two double bedrooms and reception room, plus well-specified kitchen area and shower room, the flat is offered with a share of the property’s freehold. Clapton is a popular area with excellent amenities and transport links. The flat occupies the majority of the first floor of an impressive, converted double-fronted Edwardian villa and is set on a wonderful tree-lined residential street, surrounded by similarly attractive properties. As you enter from the front door, to the right and across the hallway is bedroom two – which has a large sash window looking out to the rear of the property. The room offers a built-in storage cupboard which leaves room for a double bed, side cabinets and additional chests of drawers. Back to the hallway and on your right, you’ll find a wide squared archway which leads into the bright reception room. A large east-facing bay with tall sash windows provides exceptional natural light and there’s generous room for a large settee, entertainment unit and bookcases. The size of the room would allow for a large, stylish centre rug completed by a feature coffee table. Opposite the bay window, at the far end of this large room is the kitchen area. The L-shaped design includes a range of base and wall cabinets and a full height, integrated fridge/freezer. Cabinets are gloss white in a shaker-style with modern chrome handles, and the countertops are in a high-quality solid timber. There’s a stainless-steel sink with modern chrome mixer tap, a washing machine, a built-in stainless-steel cooker and a gas hob with extractor above. Backsplashes are formed from stone grey mosaic tiles and there are two vertical panels of glass blocks which add an interesting design touch and serve to provide additional light into the internal hallway. Flooring throughout this space is high quality engineered timber and there are three radiators which follow the form of the bay window. Returning to the hallway, to your right is the stylish shower room. There’s a high quality, wall-mounted vanity unit comprising of a large basin with mono-block tap and two drawers below, plus a wall-mounted mirror with a shelf. The large walk-in shower cubicle with glazed panel has a rainfall shower above and a separate wall-mounted shower head, and there’s a cleverly designed shelf set into the wall. There’s a modern low-flush WC, with a built-in cupboard behind, which houses and conceals the central heating boiler. The final room at the far end of the hallway is bedroom one, which looks out to the front of the property. This is a good sized double room with a large wardrobe including both hanging space and drawers. There’s space for a double bed and bedside cabinets with room left over for additional storage, a dressing table or an armchair. The property is ideally located directly between the fabulous facilities offered by the Upper Clapton Road and the relaxing green spaces of Springfield and Millfield Parks. Upper Clapton Road and the surrounding streets provide every conceivable amenity, including a host of independent shops and hospitality businesses, such as the Crooked Billet Pub and Restaurant, Sodo Pizza and The Dialogue Café. There are supermarkets, pharmacies, health centres and schools within a few minutes’ walk including the Ofsted outstanding-rated Southwold Primary School. The property is also only a few minutes’ walk from the River Lea, where you can take relaxing walks alongside the many narrow boats, with riverside pubs such as the Princess of Wales and the Anchor & Hope and cross to the wonderful open spaces of the Hackney and Walthamstow Marshes and Lee Valley Park. Clapton Overground station is just five minutes’ away, which will get you into central London in less than 20 minutes and there are excellent bus services accessible on the doorstep. The property is currently tenanted. These property particulars have been prepared by Trading Places Estate and Letting Agents under the instruction of the owner and shall not constitute an offer or the basis of any contract. They are created as a general guide and our visit to the property was for the purpose of preparing these particulars. No form of survey, structural or otherwise was carried out. results.summary: The Personal Agent are delighted to offer for sale this 1546 sq ft extended four bedroom semi detached house. The property benefits from a 27'9 x 18'8 kitchen / dining / living room and a separate 13'5 x 12'2 reception room. This quiet and much requested cul de sac enjoys a fantastic position and is within walking distance of the heart of the village with its excellent High Street shopping that includes a Waitrose Supermarket and the M&S Simply Food store. The village also has numerous high quality cafes and restaurants. Nearby the open spaces of Banstead Downs provides beautiful walks and cycling routes, Oaks Park and Epsom Downs are also easily reached. The property comprises of a porch leading to a hallway where you have access to the front reception room and the open plan kitchen / dining / living room. Additionally there is access to the downstairs cloakroom and utility room. On the first floor there are four bedrooms, three of which are doubles. The primary bedroom benefits from an en suite shower room and the main bathroom completes the accommodation. Outside there is a patio and lawn area to the rear and to the front is a driveway for ample parking and a 8'8 x 8'6 part converted garage. The A217 provides an arterial route to London and the M25 motorway at Reigate Hill (J8), and there are rail services at Banstead Station some 0.6 of a mile away. In short, the property enjoys an ideal location for accessing the area's many cultural, leisure and sport venues. The entrance hall showcases exquisite detailing, including decorative panelling and elegant tiling, setting the tone for the rest of the home. At the heart of the property lies a stunning open plan kitchen and family room, providing an ideal space for modern living and entertaining. The sleek kitchen is beautifully appointed with a central island, integrated appliances, and an instant hot water tap, while polished concrete floors with underfloor heating run throughout this space. Generous dining and seating areas are enhanced by sliding doors opening onto the rear garden, complete with electric roller blinds for added convenience and comfort. To the front, a cosy yet elegant living room features a charming bay window and a striking Victorian fireplace with a Nero Marquina black marble surround, creating a warm and inviting atmosphere. Bespoke doors run throughout the home, fitted with Burlington solid brass handles, while the front door is enhanced by Banham solid brass furniture. Cast iron radiators provide comfort across all rooms, and a ground floor guest WC completes this level. The first floor comprises two well-proportioned double bedrooms, each benefiting from stylish en suite bathrooms adorned with fluted Carrara marble tiles. One bedrooms features bespoke Hammond fitted wardrobes, providing elegant and practical storage solutions. On the second floor, there are two further bedrooms, with one benefitting from custom Hammond wardrobes and eaves storage, served by a contemporary family shower room, also finished with fluted Carrara marble tiles. The property further benefits from bespoke handleless under stairs storage, adding smart, hidden functionality throughout the home. Externally, the property is beautifully presented, with sawn Yorkstone paving extending across both the front and rear gardens, creating stylish spaces for welcoming guests and al fresco entertaining. The rear garden is further enhanced by a versatile garden room outbuilding, while the front retains its original cast iron railings, adding period character and elegance. This location offers an exceptional balance of connectivity, green space and lifestyle appeal. Residents benefit from swift Central Line access via both Wanstead and Snaresbrook Underground Stations, placing the City and West End within easy reach, while a collection of Overground links and local bus routes ensure seamless travel across London. The area is defined by its proximity to expansive open spaces including Wanstead Flats, Hackney Marshes and the wider Epping Forest, offering a rare sense of openness and escape. The vibrant community hub of Francis Road provides an array of independent cafés, boutiques and artisanal offerings, complemented by the extensive retail and leisure amenities of Westfield Stratford City. results.summary: A unique and rare freehold residential warehouse conversion in Victoria Park. The building began life as a Victorian bobbin factory and its industrial past is still legible in the proportions: wide open floors, high ceilings, with an ease of movement across more than 3,400 sqft (approx.) over two lateral levels. The renovation, led by architects Studio Ageli and an artist-owner, allows the past to remain visible while adapting the structure for contemporary family life. In the 1980s, the basement was excavated by a community group and used as a wine cellar and workshop; in the 1990s, the building became a nursery. Original stepped brickwork remains exposed in places, particularly around former fireplaces, and reclaimed hardwood flooring—salvaged from a Glasgow sports hall—runs through the upper floor and selected rooms below, its coloured striping a subtle record of former use. Structural elements have been deliberately revealed. Original A-frames are exposed upstairs, while beams on the lower level are picked out in yellow, creating a gentle rhythm between old and new. Above the main living area, an expansive skylight—lowered into place by crane—draws daylight deep into the plan, emphasising the height of the stairwell and the openness of the upper floor. The kitchen and adjoining library were designed by the owner and function as working spaces as much as social ones. The kitchen is anchored by a Rangemaster, while the library uses bespoke tropical hardwood, integrated lighting and raised shelving that treats books and objects as part of the architecture. Elsewhere, wall space has been left intentionally open, allowing the house to operate as a backdrop for large-scale artworks. Upstairs living areas include a built-in projection system and cinema screen, while air-source heat pumps and discreet air conditioning serve the principal rooms and bedrooms. Bathrooms upstairs are finished in pink and white marble, contrasting softly with the industrial envelope. Storage is embedded throughout—from stair voids to overhead spaces—alongside internal bike racks and a separate utility room. Externally, the roof has been renovated and fitted with solar panels across half of the building. Bespoke double-glazed sash windows follow the original Victorian façade, maintaining the building’s street presence. Set in the midst of traditional Victorian terraced houses commonly known in the Bow conservation area, this unique home is a hidden gem with doors opening from the house into a private courtyard. The property is directly situated by Victoria Park with its vast open green spaces, cafes and amenities. Victoria Park Village is a short walk away, with independent shops, food stores and restaurants woven into daily life. Mile End tube, Canary Wharf, the City, London Fields and Hackney Wick are all easily reached by a walk, bike or multiple bus routes and several well-regarded local schools are nearby. The result is a house shaped less by trend than by accumulation—of materials, uses and decisions—where industrial history, domestic life and artistic practice sit comfortably alongside one another. results.summary: With a private entrance and direct access to an outstanding communal garden, is this spacious one double bedroom, plus a study, period conversion just 0.4 miles from Blackheath Village with off street parking and sold chain free. Located on the lower ground floor of this impressive period home, the property is in excellent decorative order with the accommodation comprising; a large 14’10 x 12’7 reception room leading to semi open plan modern kitchen and with double doors to a huge landscaped communal garden. There is a large 14’11 x 12’1 master bedroom, a modern bathroom and large storage cupboard. In addition to the bedroom there is another good sized room which cannot technically be called a bedroom as it does not have a window although works very well as a study or dressing room. The property further benefits from off street parking, and is sold with a share of the freehold. This is a wonderful apartment and your immediate viewing is highly recommended. Video tour can be seen at winkworth.co.uk The property is in a sought after location within the Blackheath Park Conservation Area and just 0.4 miles from Blackheath Village with its array of bars, restaurants, boutique shops and mainline station. The fabulous Royal Greenwich Park is 1 mile away with Greenwich town centre beyond. Greenwich maintains a quaint rural village feel and is steeped in history with the old Royal Naval Hospital, the Royal Observatory, the National Maritime Museum, and the spectacularly restored Cutty Sark, the last of the great tea clippers. Greenwich's covered market is one of London’s best and attracts people from all over the capital. There are fantastic transport links with Blackheath Station giving access to London Bridge, Charing Cross and Victoria amongst others with access to the DLR, London Overground, bus, riverboat, foot tunnel and cable car all within the area. The area is minutes from Canary Wharf, the City and central London; Just one of the reasons why it's increasingly popular with young professionals and commuters. The O2 is also close by. As well as outstanding local primary state schools, there are several highly sought-after independent schools including; Blackheath Preparatory School, The Pointer School, Heath House Preparatory School, Blackheath High Junior School, Blackheath High Seniors School, Colfes (1.4 miles) and Eltham College (2.4 miles).
